tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ka)༄༅/ /sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi yi ge rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na ma āryā tā rā yai/
(ka)༄༅/ /sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi yi ge rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na ma āryā tā rā yai/

tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi yi ge rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na ma āryā tā rā yai/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyid kyis rjes su gnang ba mdzad pa la brten nas slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas 'chi ba slu ba bsdus pa'i rtog pa nas 'di phyung bar mdzad/ man ngag rnams sgrol ma nyid kyis gsungs skad/ de la bla ma rdo rje gdan pas gsan nas/ sgrub thabs kyang mang du mdzad/ de la bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas gsan/ sgrub thabs kyang mang po bod du bsgyur/ de la bla ma gle nag pas gsan sgrub pa lo drug mdzad pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs te chos gsungs skad/ de la sgre pa rin po ches gsan te/ dang po thos bsam mdzad pa'i dus su la stod stag ri ba yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa gcig la lag ris bstan pas/ jo bo btsun pa khyod la chos kyi las 'phro gsha' ma gcig 'dug pa la tshe la longs mi 'dug ste/ lo gsum las mi thub par 'dug zer ba dang*/ sngar nas khong rang gi rmi lam du ltas ngan yang yang byung ba gnyis 'dzom pas/ tshe 'di la thugs gsha' ma rang byung ste lo gcig thub bam ji tsam thub thub kyi tshe lhag ma 'di la chos lag len gsha' mar thebs pa gcig bya/ de la thog mar gdams ngag khyad par can ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig btsal dgos dgongs nas gsan 'phro bcad nas dbus su byon pa'i lam khar gzhu'i mkhar gong du bla ma gle nag pa dang mjal nas lo rgyus byas pas/ byang chub sgrub pa la lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i thabs khyad par can nga la yod kyi/ ston pa khyod thugs bde 'bol gyis thong zhig gsungs nas 'di'i sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnang*/ da khyod kyis gzhan du ma 'gro bar 'di rang du sdod la sgoms shig gsungs nas/ lung pa de rang gi lung lag mkhar lung bya ba cig gi phur sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas zla ba bcu gcig lon tsa na rje btsun ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas khyod kyis lo drug cu tsam thub/

sems can la phan thogs pa 'ongs gsungs/ de nas phyis dgung lo drug cu lon pa'i dus su rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ nga'i sku gcig bzhengs dang lo bcu tsam sdod par 'dug gi gsungs nas ras bris gcig bzhengs skad/ dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa'i dus su gsol ba btab pas yang nga'i sku gcig bzhengs dang lo bcu thub par 'dug gsungs nas/ lugs ma gcig bzhengs skad/ sku de gnyis byin rlabs che bar grags te/ ras bris de da lta ra sgreng na bzhugs skad/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i dus su rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ da dung nga yi sku gcig bzhengs na/ lo mang du thub par 'dug gsungs pa la/ khong rang bzhugs pa'i mdun gyi gyang logs la ri mo cig bzhengs skad/ de nas lo bco lnga'i bar du bzhugs te/ yongs su rdzogs pa dgu lo dgu bcu rtsa lngar bzhugs skad do// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ gle nag pa/ sgre pa/ zhu ston/ a seng*/ ratna dhwa dza/ yang spyan snga ba/ dwags po lha rje/ zhang sum thog pa/ ska tshal pa/ lha paṇḍi ta/

bla ma lha pa/ ratna bha dra/ rin chen bzang po/ ratna dhwa dza'o/ lho brag pa/ /spyan snga ba'i zhal nas 'di'i bsnyen pa 'bum tsho gcig bskyar na bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs gsungs/ 'di phrin las kyi lha mo yin pas 'grub sla ba yin gsungs so// dge bshes gle nag pa'i zhal nas/ 'di zlos shes na mgo sug bral yang 'gal ba med/ ro khung brus kyang 'gal ba med/ sha dum bu dum bur 'thor gyin song yang 'gal ba med gsungs so// 'chi ba slu ba'i sgrol ma'i lo rgyus rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ si tā tā rā sā dha naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ched du zla ba drug gi bar// sgrol ma'i 'khor lo bsgoms byas pas// dngos grub thams cad thob 'gyur zhing*// 'chi ba'i skyon gyis mi gos so// ngag gi dbang phyug snang byas pa'i// 'chi bdag slu ba bsdus pa las// phyungs nas sgrol ma dkar mo 'di// bsgoms pas 'jigs pa nyams byed pa// bzhi pa'i sde tshan dang po oṃ// bcas pa nam mkhar 'od zer 'phros// pad dkar zla ba'i steng gnas pa'i// gsum la skyabs 'gro yang brjod bya// rang bzhin sgro btags gzhi med du// skad cig stong pa nyid du lta// de nas sngon gyi smon lam dbang*// byang chub sems kyi yi ge bsgom// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ni// sa bon yi ge'i 'phro 'du las// rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas pa'i// mchog sbyin pa dang utpal 'dzin// ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od rnam can// zla ba'i rgyab la mnyam brten pa'o// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// bcu drug lo lon lus can ma// sangs rgyas kun kyang de yi sras// yum ni 'dod pa'i gzugs 'dzin ma// sgrol ma de yi snying gar bsgom// 'khor lo 'od zer dkar po can// re'u mig brgyad la yi ge ni// brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o// oṃ hā gsal byed dbus gnas pa// bsgrub bya'i ming ni lte bar bya// zla ba drug tu tshangs yid kyis// nges pa brtan po dag tu bya// yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni// mi skyo'i yid kyis bzla bar bya// oṃ gyi yi ge dang por sbyin// phyis ni tā re rab tu sbyin// tuttā re dang tu re phyi// swā hā mtha' ru las kun byed// tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo'ang bskyod mi nus// 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma bzhin// skra dkar gnyer ma rgas nad dang*// dbul ba nyams sogs mdor bsdu na// seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// du ma rab tu 'joms par byed// skul ba med par gos btung ba// kha zas rin chen tshogs kyang 'du// ral gri dang ni mig sman dang*// rkang pa bum pa bzang po 'grub/

nad dang 'chi ba rnams nyams pa'o/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub pas ni// tshigs bcad mkhas dang snyan ngag dang*// blo rno shes rab dri med 'gyur// gzhan yang dngos grub ci 'dod pa// 'khor lo de las 'byung bar 'gyur// gang zhig byung ba'i dge bsags pas// des ni myur du sgrol mar shog /sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khams pa ba ris bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs bum chog gtor ma/ srung 'khor gyi yi ge bzhugs so// ༈ /'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sgrub pa'i gang zag 'chi ltas kyi mtshan ma tshang na 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgo nas 'chi ba slu ba'i gdams ngag ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gzhan dang mthun/ khyad par du bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ sgrol ma dkar mo bsgom snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas rang tha mal pa'i snying gar pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig dkar po zhig bsam/ de nas/ swa bhā was skad cig gis chos thams cad gzhi med stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i ngang nas paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig dkar po 'od 'phro ba zhig bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus nas 'od du zhu ba las bdag nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon utpal bsnams pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ltag par bcings pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsgom par bya'o// de'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la dbus su tām̐ yig bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs rang la bstim/

gnas gsum yi ges brgyan/ dbang bskur snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas tām̐ la yi ge bcu pas bskor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya ba'am yang na 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ dang hā gnyis bsam/ rtsibs brgyad la tā la sogs pa brgyad bsam/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re bdag gi tshe 'phel bar gyur cig swā hā/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba la shes pa gtad de yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ rdzogs rim dmigs med du bskyal/ de nas sgyu ma lta bur langs la bya ba gzhan la 'jug de lta bu zhag gam lo'i bar du mtshan ma'i rtags ma byung gi bar bya'o// mtshan ma ngan nges na bya ba yin gsungs/ gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na rin po che'i snod du dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma bshams la/ de'i nang zla ba'i steng tām̐ yig dkar po bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros nas snod la phog pas rin po cher gyur/ bcud la phog pas skyon dag par bsam/ tām̐ zhu nas thim pas bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas mgron spyan drangs pa ni gzhan dang mthun/ tām̐ las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad mdun du spyan drangs/ yang 'od kyis sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sgrol mar gyur ba'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol bar bsams la gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa bya bar gsungs so// bum chog byed par 'dod na/ bum pa bca' ba gzhan dang mthun/ rang gi mdun du padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su bzhag mchod pa la sogs pa bsham/ bhrūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ nang du pad zla'i steng du cho ga gsum gyis sgrol ma bsgom/ de'i thugs kar sngags kyi 'od zer thim pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa khengs par bsam zhing bsnyen pa brgya stong la sogs par bya'o// de nas bum pa'i lha la gsol ba gdab/ bstod pa bkra shis la sogs pa byas la/ lha bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams nas rang gzhan la khrus bya/

yi ge bcu pa'i sham bu la zhi rgyas dbang drag skabs dang sbyar la brjod/ gzungs nar ma la sogs par mar dang bdud rtsi sbags la bya/ srung 'khor bsgom par 'dod na mi dmigs pa'i ngang las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bsam/ de'i dbus su padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su rang rdzus skyes kyi sgrol ma dkar mo gzhung bzhin du bsgom/ gzhan srung na yang rang la bsrung byas bskor bar bsgom/ phyi rol du 'khor lo g.yas bskor du 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya gsungs so// ༈ /sgrol dkar gyi bris pa'i srung 'khor gyi yi ge bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yi// srung ba'i 'khor lo'i gdams ngag ni// gro ga la sogs gang rung la// rtsibs brgyad rdo rje'i rwa bar bcas// phyi rol utpa las bskor bri// lte bar oṃ dang hā yi bar// rakṣa rakṣa ku ru zhes// gang bsrung ming ni spel bar bya// rtsibs brgyad tā re la sogs brgyad// bum pa'i maṇḍal steng du bzhag /de nas rnal 'byor rang nyid ni// dang po byams pa snying rje bsgom// de nas rang nyid skad cig gis// sgrol ma dkar mor gyur par bsam// de nas stong pa nyid ngang las// chu bo chen po'i steng du ni// tsakra de nyid bzhugs par bsgom// dkon mchog pū dza la sogs bsham// skad cig gis ni tsakra yi// yig 'bru rnams la rje btsun ma// sgrol ma mngon du gyur par bsgom// bdag dang de las 'od 'phros pas// 'og min gnas nas ye shes ma// spyan drangs bstim la mchod bstod bya// bzlas pa khri phrag lnga'am ni// yang na 'bum phrag gcig tu bya// bar chad zhi dang tshe ring dang*// gzhan yang gang 'os gsol ba gdab// dngos grub zhal bzhes grub pa dang*// jo mo de rnams yig 'bru yi// rang bzhin nyid du bsam byas la// de nas legs par bltabs byas shing*// gang bsrung lus la btags par bya// de la yon tan dpag tu med// ///

༈ /sgrol dkar gyi bar chad zhi bar byed pa'i yi ge bzhugs so// bar chad zhi bar byed pa ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i man ngag ni/ rang sgrol ma dkar mor bsams la/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rang la gnod byed mdun du bkug nas sgrol ma dkar mor bsgoms la/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bstim/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa sna lnga dbul/ gang 'dod pa'i gsol ba gdab/ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ de ltar byas na gnod byed bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs gsungs so// chag che na 'khor lo'i gur khang gi gdams ngag ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs sprad gur khang zhwa theb sprad pa lta bu'i nang gi lte ba la/ rang nyid sgrol mar bskyed/ lte bar oṃ dang hā bsam/ rtsibs brgyad la yi ge brgyad/ de nas yi ge bcu pa bzla'o// chag che ba thams cad bzlog go /gzhan yang 'jigs pa bsrung ba la sogs pa thams cad ming spel bsgyur la bya gsungs so// /// ༈ /sgrol ma'i byad 'grol gyi yi ge slob dpon padma nag pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mastā rā yi/ ngag gi byad 'grol ba ni/ rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ mchod pa rnam lnga 'bul/ bdun rnam dag byas la/ bdag gi ngag bcings pa dang mnan pa las dgrol du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rang gi snying gar ram̐ las me'i rang bzhin e dmar po gcig bsam/ mgrin par na nag po gcig bsam/ lce rtser st+wam̐ yig nag po gcig bsam/ spyan drangs pa'i yi dam lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi snying ga'i ram̐ yig la phog pas dmar lam gyis song bas/ na nag po dang st+wam̐ gnyis thul gyis tshig par bsam/ de nas yi dam de rang la thim par bsams la/ oṃ dzi hwā saṃ rakṣa ni hūm̐/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// oṃ tā re tā ra ye bha ga wa tī dzi hwā bha ga wān bhandha mo tsa ni swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas lce rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po 'bar ba mthu dang ldan par bsam mo// ngag gi byad 'grol ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma nag pos mdzad pa/

lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o// ngag gi byad 'grol rdzogs so/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol ma'i sgrib shing gi yi ge klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib shing gi 'khor lo 'di la nang gi rtsibs dang phyi'i rtsibs mchan yi ge gnyis gi'u haṃ gis bri/ nang gi rtsibs mchan dang bcas pa dang phyi'i rtsibs kyi yi ge gur gum gyis bris/ rtsi ma gi ta gla rtsi dri tshor tsam re btang*/ phyag mtshan gyi dam tshig la rma bya'i mdongs ma nyams pa gcig gzhug rab gnas bya thabs bla ma'i zhal las shes/ 'khor lo ni dkyil 'khor lha'i gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du utpal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma sku mdog ljang gu don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon utpal bsnams pa/ mdzes shing sgeg pa'i cha byad du bsgom/ de'i thugs kar bsrung bya bsams la/ rtsa sngags dang rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa re bzlas nas me tog gtor la mgul du gdags so// bris ma thag sa la mi bzhag pa dang mi lag mi 'grim pa gal che gsungs/ lte ba la rakṣa srungs shig 'chang ba po la sgribs shig ces bri'o// 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'o// paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba ba ris bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /sgrol ma'i sprul pa ce spyang sdon mo'i srung ba bzhugs so// na ma āryā tā rā yai/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa ce spyang sngon mos gnas dang rkun ma srung ba ni/ ce spyang gi gzugs bris la/ kha ma tshul mjug ma'i ngos su bstan pa bri/ gnas srung na khog par yi ge bcu pa dang*/ gnas 'dir chom rkun ma btang zhig ces pa bri/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la skyabs su mchi'o// dpal bhi ma dhe ba'i ce spyang sngon mos gnas 'dir chom rkun ma btang zhig

oṃ sū me sū ma bidhya dhe ma gnas 'dir chom rkun rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ ce spyang la khor yug du bri'o// rkun ma srung na ce spyang gi lto ba la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la yi ge bcu pa dang*/ lte bar oṃ dang hā'i bar du/ gnas 'dir chom rkun rakṣa rakṣa/ oṃ aṃ rkun ma thams cad tsakṣuḥtsakṣuḥbhandha bhandha rakṣa rakṣa/ zhes tshar gsum bri/ de nas sngags rnams dri bzang gis byugs/ ras gtsang ma'i steng du tsakra rnams bkram la/ rang bzhin sgrol ma la rnam pa ce spyang gi gzugs su bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim/ yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ sū me brgya rtsa re dang*/ rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa bcas rab gnas byas la/ tsakra legs par dril nas gnas srung dang rkun srung gnyis sgo khang du sba'o// gnas srung rkun srung lam srung gsum the tshom med pa'i gdams ngag yin/ zab bo// gsang ngo*// ༈ /ce spyang sngon mo'i lam srung gi gsal byed bzhugs so// 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrol ma'i sprul pa ce spyang gi gzugs bris la/ dri byugs sngags dpe chung ltar dgod/ de nas dben pa'i gnas su rin po che'i snod du mchod pa lnga bsham/ gtor ma gcig kyang bsham/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ khyad par du bdag gi byang chub bsgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung*/ de'i ched du 'di bya snyam du byas la/ de nas mdun gyi gzugs brnyan de mi dmigs pa las sgrol ma'i sprul pa de/ ngo bo rje btsun ma rnam pa ce spyang sngon mor bsams la/ rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun du bskyed pa kho na 'dra ba gcig spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug bcings pa dang dgyes pa bskyed/ mchod pa lnga dbul/ gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ oṃ sū me sū ma bi dhye dhye swā hā/ zhes khri la sogs pa dang rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas pa'i nas 'bru gzugs la gtor ro// ba linta kha 'bar mas byin gyis brlabs te ce spyang la phul nas gsol ba gdab/

de nas legs par dril te rang srung lus la gdags/ rkun srung dang gnas srung gnyis sgo'i ma them la khung brus la mi mthong bar sba/ lam du 'gro na mdun du ce spyang wal gyis bskyed la ye shes pa bstims nas/ dpal bi ma dhe pa'i ce spyang sngon mo la bdag skyabs su mchi'o// zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang gis sna drangs nas 'gro bar bsam na nges par 'grub bo// ce spyang sngon mo'i lam srung zab bo// / maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa rdo rje gdan pa dang*// ba ri lo tsā grub chen gle nag par// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bshes gnyen sgre pa mnyam med sgam po pa// sgom tshul shes rab byang chub 'dul 'dzin zhabs// 'bri gung gling pa dam chos gling pa la// gsol ba 'debs so= /chos kyi tshul khrims mnyam med lha lung pa// thog gnas pa dang chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs// skye rgu'i 'dren mchog byang chub bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so= /thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs// bsod nams lha dbang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dang*// mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun phrin las par// gsol ba 'debs so= /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rje btsun bcom ldan ma// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku yi snang brnyan ni// blo mtshor shar ba'i mod nas 'chi bdag bdud// ming gi mthar byas 'chi med 'grub par shog /snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lor yig 'brur bcas// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar babs pa yis// lus kun phyur bur gtams pa'i dga' ston gyis// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub 'grub par shog /'od zer drug sgrags ldan pa'i srung 'khor ni// utpal gsar pas bar mtshams kun khyab pa// sra brtan rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgoms pa yis// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog

/ces pa 'di yang bande blo gsal gyis sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ /gong gi brgyud pa'i kha skong la/ rjes gnang rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun phrin las par// gsol ba 'debs so= zhes pa'i mtshams/ tshar chen rje dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub la// gsol ba 'debs= /mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar pa// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// rigs kun khyab bdag kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so= /zhes dang*/ khrid kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ bsod nams mchog grub rjes su/ rin chen 'jam dpal blo gsal bstan 'dzin dang*// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// 'chi med dpal ster kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so= /zhes sam/ yang na/ kun dga' blo gros chos nyid ye shes dang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so= /'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dang*// blo gsal bstan skyong rnam 'dren ngag gi dbang*// 'chi med dpal ster kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so= /zhes sam/ yang na/ kun dga' blo gros chos nyid ye shes dang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so= /'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dang*// blo gsal bstan skyong rnam 'dren ngag gi dbang*// snyan brgyud dpal ster rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rgyal ba'i yum mchog sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas sbyar ba dge/ ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying por bsdus pa bzhugs so// na ma ārya tā rā yai/ zla shel padmo bzhad pa'i lte ba la// zla ba zhun ma'i yid 'phrog lang tsho can// zla zhal mthong bas dga' bde'i dpal ster ma// zla ba'i chu rgyun bdud rtsis ring du skyongs// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub par byed pa'i thabs ches zab pa tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun du grags pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bsdus te rgyun tu nyams len 'dod pas bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi 'gro ltar byas la/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ces pas spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ nam ārya tā re sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ ces pas phyag bya/ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong bar gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing*/ nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas utpal dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i brdar rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus kyi me tog kha bye ba/ g.yas 'bras bu/ g.yon gang bu'i rnam par yod pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing*/ lan bu ring du 'phyangs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/

dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun mnga' ba/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor can/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ lha'i sku snang stong dbyer med la sems gtad de/ ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor ba/ mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru re re yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud nang ma la/

a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa g.yon skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol mu khyud la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ/ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ye dharmāḥhe tu pra bhā wa he tunte ṣanta thā ga to hya ba datā te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ/ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod par bsam/ de nas spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bum pa 'chi med bdud rtse'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bum pa'i nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad dag 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsam/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang*/ 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis khengs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad byang zhing dag

'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phrom mer yod par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng tām̐ yig dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ lus kyi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dkar po'i gur khang du gyur/ zhi ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ser po gser zhun ma lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dkar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ser po'i gur khang du gyur/ rgyas pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po bye ru'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ser po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dmar po'i gur khang du gyur/ dbang gi phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dmar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mthing ga'i gur khang du gyur/ drag po'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ljang gu margad zhun ma'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig char du 'grub par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od mthing ga'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ljang gu'i gur khang du gyur/

phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mchin kha 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'od ljang gu'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mchin kha'i gur khang du gyur/ byin rlabs dang phrin las thams cad brtan par bsam/ 'od kyi gur khang drug po thams cad dbyibs sgo nga'i rnam pa lta bu dum bu gcig tu gyur pa sra zhing mkhregs pa bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa/ bar mtshams thams cad utpal sngon po me tog kha bye ma thag pa gsar zhing mnyen lcug dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par bsam/ bye brag tu bgegs la sogs pa'i gnod pa srung bar 'dod pas 'od dkar po'i gur khang gi nang rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu g.yas skor du 'khor ba me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi so mal du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul tshig par bsam/ de ltar rang nyid rje btsun ma gsal ba nas bzung*/ phyi'i 'od zer mchin kha'i gur khang gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog de bzhin du phyi nas rim bzhin thugs ka'i tām̐ yig gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong gi ngang du mnyam par 'jog des sems dub na gong bzhin snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi babs cing 'od zer gyi spro bsdu'i ngang nas/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇya dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i rjes su/ sngar ltar mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyis byin rlabs brtan zhing lhag chad kha bskang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ lo brgya thub cing sogs kyi smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do// de ltar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la/

jo bo rje nas brgyud pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ste/ bod yul du brgyud pa'i srol mi 'dra ba bzhi tsam byon pa'i man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa/ gtso cher ba ri ba'i slob brgyud bla ma gle nag pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa la gnang ba'i nyams len ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud dang bcas pa 'di ni/ tshe sgrub kyi man ngag la zab pa'i mthar thug par grags so// zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po zhal ngo rnams kyi rgyun gyi nyams bzhes su/ rgyal khams myul ba'i bande blo gsal gyis phun tshogs rnam rgyal rab brtan rtse'i gzims chung bdud 'dul bde chen gling du legs par sbyar ba maṅga laṃ// yi ge pa ni rje de nyid kyi sku drin kho nas 'tsho ba'i bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bgyis pa'o// i daṃ shā sa nañtsa sarba sa twā hi to bha bantu// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bande mkhyen brtses bgyis pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bzlas rnams grub rjes/ maṇḍal/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// nas/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyi rgyun bshags/ bla ma rin po ches bdag gi dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal nas/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyis khyad par gyi gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od 'phros slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib nad gdon dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs/

der ma zad rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus stong par sbyangs/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i steng du slob ma'i rnam shes tām̐ yig dkar po las mngon rtogs ltar sgrol ma'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bskyed/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bsam/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang*/ khyad par rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog cing 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i rnam pas nam mkha' gang bar byon pa dang*/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon las kyang de 'dra ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa chad/ slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad nas kyang thogs med du zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim pas de las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa skya chi li li babs/ lus thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis khengs/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sangs kyis dag tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ ā be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ci mang brjod cing rdor dril gsor dkrol bya/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i lha tshogs oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ dang*/ yi ge bcu pa brjod cing bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma la thim/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs shlo ka gsum gyis shis pa brjod/

mchod pa lngas mchod pa ni lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo las sngags phreng chad/ zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma'i zhal nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i yig 'bru la thim par bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa la spel tshig can brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rjes zlos bya/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya ba ni sngags bzla ba'i rjes gnang ngo*// dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar du yi dam du bzung snyam pas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal ba dang*// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes me tog gtor/ mjug dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang*/ yon 'bul cho ga spyi dang 'dra/ 'di'i bdag mdun bum gsum bskyed tshul la khyad par med cing*/ mngon rtogs pa bla mas mdzad pa'i rgyas pa de sor bzhag dang*/ bsdus pa de yin na mdun bum gnyis la gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab pa nges par bya dgos/ bdag bskyed la'ang byas na legs/ gtor ma ni mdun bskyed kyi mchod bstod grub mtshams/ dkar cha bzhi nas 'byung ba ji lta bas 'bul/ gzhan mchod bstod thams cad rgyas bsdus skabs su gang babs kyis 'grub/ brgya tshar sogs mdzad na/ thog ma de la 'di kha sor bzhag gnyis pa man la maṇḍal sa gzhi spos byugs/ gsol gdab bstod pa gnyis tshar gcig gi rjes su thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab sbyar/

rgyun bshags mi dgos/ bzlas lung la sngags gsum gsum mdzad/ gzhan dkyus bzhin mdzad pa phyag len yin no// ༈ /sgrol dkar rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa'i zin bris dge/ swa sti/ gong gi rjes gnang de thun mong ba yin/ thun mong ma yin pa khrid kyi sngon 'gro sogs kyi tshe/ spyi bshad ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes 'di'i lo rgyus sbyar/ maṇḍal nas/ dam tshig pa'i 'khor lo bskyed pa'i bar 'dra/ de ltar gsal ba'i phyi rol du 'khor lo dkar po sogs nas bun long gis gtams pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bar gyis 'khor lo dang 'od zer drug sbrag gi dmigs pa sgrub thabs ltar phog gnas gsum byin rlabs nas/ mchod pa lngas mchod pa'i bar 'dra/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas yig 'bru la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las mgon po tshe dpag med nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig nas/ zil pa phram mer yod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos brgya rtsa brgyad mdzod/ ces tshe bcud sdud pa'i dmigs pa sgrub thabs ltar phog la/ rtsa sngags spel tshig bcas brgya rtsa/ dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams gsum re/ mthar bcom ldan bdag la dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la dang*/ dam bca' ba'i lung dkyus ltar/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ thugs ka'i tām̐ yig la sems gtad pas/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas 'od mchin kha'i gur khang la thim nas/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur pa'i mos pa dang bcas cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ste/ so so'i rtog pa bskyed pa spyi ltar sbyar ro// de rnams brtan par bya ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes me tog dor ba'i bar dkyus bzhin no// zhes pa'ang rje bla ma'i gsan thor snyan brgyud zhal shes zin bris su gnang ba bzhin bris pa'o// shubhaṃ// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid kyi dmigs rim zin bris bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ skyabs yul zhing khams yongs su dag pa'i dbus su/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dpag bsam shing gi sdong po'i steng padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la sgrol dkar sogs yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas thub dbang sogs sprul sku'i rnam pa/ rgyab tu gsung rab pusti brtsegs pa/ g.yon du nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs dge 'dun/ gzhan yang skyabs yul rnams kyis dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lo ma/ me tog gi khrod thams cad gang ba la dmigs nas bdag gzhan thams cad lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa spyi ltar byas nas/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes pa nas/ spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas rang nyid kyi phyi rol du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu g.yas skor du 'khor ba me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi sol mal du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul tshig par bsam/ de nas snying ga'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros/

zhes pa nas/ bar mtshams thams cad utpa la sngon po me tog kha bye ma thag pa gsar zhing mnyen lcug dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar gyi 'od zer drug sbrag bsgoms la/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba nas bzung*/ 'od zer mchin kha'i gur khang gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog de bzhin du phyi nas rim bzhin thugs ka'i tām̐ yig gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog de nas spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bum pa'i nang du song bas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad dag cing 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam la/ rlung bum pa can nyer gcig gam/ bdun nam/ gsum gyi bar du 'dzin/ de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang*/ 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad byang zhing dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer yod par bsams la/ sngags spel tshig can bzla/ dmigs pa nam mi gsal ba'i dus snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi 'bebs shing*/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu'i tshig gong bzhin brjod la/

sngags dang dmigs pa sprad de ye ma yengs par bzlas pa'i rjes su sngar ltar mchod cing bstod/ ā li kā li ye dharmā yi ge brgya pa rnams tshar gsum res byin rlabs brtan zhing lhag chad kha bskang*/ de nas thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud rnams la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas 'od zer mchin kha'i gur khang la thim/ de nas rim bzhin bsdus nas tām̐ yig gi nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas chu las chu bur gyi tshul gyis rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun ma thun mtshams gyi lhar gsal/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs dang*/ lo brgya thub cing*/ sogs kyis smon lam dang bkra shis brjod/ snang grags rig gsum rje btsun ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngo bor shes par byas nas spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// 'di ni rang gi go yul tsam du ma bzhag par rje bla ma nyid kyi spyan sngar phab ste dpyis phyin par byas so// zhes grub mchog tshar pa chos rje'i gsung las rnyed pa'i gsang ba rmad du byung ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa tshe dang bsod nams nyi ma bdun 'bar ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti pra dzā bhyaḥ/ rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga tshe dang bsod nams kyi nyi ma bdun 'bar ma zhes bya ba/ mtha' yas tshe dang ye shes rab 'bar ba'i// dpal mo gang zhig zhabs zung dran tsam gyis// grub gnyis yid kyi shing rta 'gengs pa'i gnyen// sgrol ma'i drin gyis khyod la shis gyur cig /rab 'byams rgyud du rgyal bas ches bsngags pa// rab 'byams phrin las sgrub byed lha mo de'i// rab 'byams sngags kyi nus ba 'byin pa'i thabs// rab 'byams dge legs ster byed 'dir bshad bya// de la rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas bsnyen pa'i kha skong ba'am/

rang gzhan gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i slad du sbyin sreg gi cho ga nyams su len par 'dod pas/ gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par/ rab brtsigs pa'am brus pa/ bsdu na bris pa'i thab bskyed chog nas 'byung ba lta bu'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla ba la tām̐ yig gam/ utpa la'am tshom bu dkar po che ba zhig bkod/ srog chags med pa'i lci ba'am/ 'o ma can gyi shing khru phyed tsam du zlum por brtsigs pa'i shar lhor zan gyi ting lo me tshang dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi g.yas su stegs gtsang ma'i steng du rim pa bzhin yam shing sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad

'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ mya ngan med cing zhi don du// rlon pa nyid ni rab tu bsngags// zhes dang*/ rgya gzhung phal cher du zhi rgyas la rlon pa kho na gsungs pas rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa'i zhal snga nas rlon pa 'ba' zhig mdzad/ rdo rje rin chen nas rlon pa bsreg tshe me pra legs pas dga' gsungs/ skam po mdzad pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas skam po mdzad pas gang bde bya'o // mthe bong las mi sbom zhing*/ mthe'u chung las mi phra ba rtsa rtse mar dang bu ram gyis byugs pa/ mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams bsham/ bsregs rdzas 'di rnams rgyas pa'i dbang du byas kyi ma 'byor na yam shing*/ mar/ til gsum med thabs med gzhan gang 'byor gyis chog par bshad/ g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod tshar gnyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang gtor ma cha gsum rnams lag len ltar bsham/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar ba/ bsang chu'i dung chos 'thor yab dang bcas pa bkod/ me yol gangs ti se'i mtshon byed so phag dkar po la wam̐ yig bris pa dang*/ thab kyi mthar dkram rgyu'i ku sha chun po brgyad/ me sbar ba'i lce mde/ me gso ba'i bud shing skam po sogs nyer mkho ma tshang ba med par 'du byas te/ snga dro dang po'am/ srod kyi thun la babs pa na/ stan bde ba la kha shar du bltas te/ skyil krung ngam tsog bur 'dug la/ thog mar bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ gsum dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ bdun nam nyer gcig dang hūm̐ ring po brjod pas byin gyis brlabs de nas gtor zhing*/ yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang ba 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ argha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ rol chen bya/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed sngon du btang la dpal 'bar sbar la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste thab la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pas me sbar/ sbyin sreg mang po byed na ting lo tsam ka sbar la/ 'jig rten pa rdzogs mtshams lta bu gang 'os thams cad sbar zhing me pra ni 'di dang gong 'og gnyis kar brtag oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing dgang blugs rkyang pa lan gsum gyis me gso/ bsang chu 'thor zhing rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis thab dang yo byad bsang*/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ thab dang yo byad thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed pa kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dbyibs zlum po mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas thams cad stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra bī dzā yai swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta/ dang rol chen bya/ yang yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi nang du pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi phyag g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna drung du bcas la/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ agna ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta de ba ṛ ṣi dwi dza sa twāṃ/

gṛ hī twā ā hu tiṃ ā ha ra/ a smin sanni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drang*/ padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ gyis gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul la/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badzra ā na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasma ku ru sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā we sha ya ho/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbang du byas/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs stong pa'i ngang las ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa bdag cag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byed pa la thogs pa med pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// 'dis bdag cag gi bgegs zhi zhing mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod la ku sha chun po brgyad/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥzhes pas rtse mo g.yas su bsten te thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskor zhing*/ yakṣa dang chus bsang*/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i kha dang*/ gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ bkod/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ lan bdun gyis bkang ste gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la thab la g.yas su zlum por bskor zhing*/

oṃ agna ye ā dī bya ā dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya bahna ya swā hā/ bdag cag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan 'bul/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra/ thams cad kyi mgor sbyar/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal pa'i stangs kas bzung*/ tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ yam shing nas bzung ku sha'i bar lha sngags 'ba' zhig gis 'bul ba'am/ spro na thog mar lha rdzas las sngags gsum spel ba lan gcig dang*/ bar skabs su rdzas sngags so so'i mjug tu thams cad tshang ba gcig 'bul ba gang bde yin pa las/ 'dir rgyas pa ltar na/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa gcig dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swā hā/ bcu dgu/ slar gong ma lta bu gcig ste nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs pa 'bul/ de bzhin 'gres shes par byas la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swā hā/ dge ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad= til/ oṃ sarba sampā de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la= zas mchog oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ bsod nams rgyas pa la= 'bras/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la= so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la= sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la=

nas/ oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la= gro/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa la= dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas ku sha rnams bdun nam nyer gcig 'bul ba'i mthar sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ ces brjod do// 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// de nas bsang chu yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zhes pa nas/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ zhes pa'i bar mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ rdo rje dril bu spos bcas 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ po ta la yi gnas mchog nas// sogs kyi mthar/ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ ārya tāre sa pa ri wā ra= sngon du 'gro bas/ arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ/ sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang 'od 'phros zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam/ yi ge bcu pa lan gcig dang*/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ lan bdun gyis blugs gzar bkang ba'i gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la thab la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ agna ye ā dī bya ā dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya bahna ya swā hā/

bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi 'gal rkyen mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis byon zan 'bul/ spro na/ dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu// zhes sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na/ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ bar rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas bzung*/ dril bu tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su gsil zhing*/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// sogs dang*/ spro na/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang*/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes pa nas/ bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gang shes pas bstod/ yam shing nas ku sha'i bar brgya'am nyer gcig la sogs pa gang 'byor me lha'i skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin la/ lha sngags spel bas dbul ba'i mthar/ bsnyen pa kha skong yin na sdig pa zhi phyir yin pas til kho nar grangs bzung ste/ de'ang bsnyen pa kha gso'i grangs lha sngags kho nar 'dzin pa mus chen 'khor lo sdom pas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la ched du gdams pa'i bzhed pa yin pas/ yi ge bcu pa'am/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig can gnyis bsnyen pa gang la song ba la grangs bzung ste/ thun re la khri tsho re sogs ci nus 'bul lo// rim gro ltar byed na slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i 'chi ba slu ba'i gzhung las/ dang por rnam par snang mdzad brjod// de'i 'og tā re lan gnyis brjod// tuttā re gnyis tu re gcig /swā hā'i mtha' can 'chi ba slu// sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs// sngags ni yi ge 'bum pa ru// sgrol ma'i spyan sngar bzlas nas ni// zho dang sbrang rtsis ngar btags pa'i// dūrba'i myu gu shar dang ni// byang du rtse bstan sbyin sreg bya// sngon gyi mthu las byung ba yi// 'chi ba nges par zlog par byed// ces gsungs pas/

dūrba'i myu gu rtse mo ma nyams pa'am/ ma 'byor na dum bur byas pa zho dang sbrang rtsi dang 'bras bsres pa 'ba' zhig lha sngags kho nas bsregs pa'i sbyin sreg khri la sogs pa byas na ched du bsngags par mngon no// slar byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba'i dgang blugs lan gsum gshegs skyems su dbul/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i/ arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇā ā dya nutpanna twa t oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ he he bha ga wa tī ma hā sa twa sarba buddha a wa lo ki te mā bi lamba mā bi lamba i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// sogs nas/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu btab/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol// oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyi mthar/ badzra muḥthab nang gi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ thab dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs te dpral bar byug cing*/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod de 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// slar thab khung du mar dgang gzar gang blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las bzhengs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas bsang gtor zhabs bsil phul/

yam shing nas ku sha'i bar bsreg rdzas rnams ji ltar 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar gong byon zan du bshad pa ltar dgang blugs lan gsum gshegs skyems su dbul/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas la/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ me ste bsregs bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// ces pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bar gyis phrin las bcol/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya tshar gsum dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon cig /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// agna ye muḥ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod/ gtor ma cha gsum ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa ltar bya'o// de nas bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs skabs su bab cing 'brel chags pa rgyas par mdzad/ sbyin sreg mang du byed na slar yang thal ba rnams cung zad bcags pa'i steng du ong ba brtsegs pa nas bkra shis kyi bar tshul snga ma ji lta bar nyams su blang bar bya'o// de ltar rab 'byams grub pa stong gi mdzod// mtha' yas bkra shis bye ba'i dpal 'bar ba// sbyin sreg nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba'i mthus// dge legs pad dkar rgya cher rgyas gyur cig /ces rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ngag 'don bklags chog tu bkod pa tshe dang bsod nams nyi ma bdun 'bar ma zhes bya ba 'di yang*/

bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che bla mar mdzad pa'i sa skyong bstan pa'i mtshan can gyis bka' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal zhwa lu'i gdan sa bcu gsum pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dpal ldan skal ba bzang po'i sdes thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung ji lta ba la phyag len gyi rim pa cher gsal bar rnga chen gyi lo snron can gyi zla ba'i tshes gcig la dpal zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang du legs par grub pa 'dis kyang rje bla ma'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du rgyas shing bkra shis bde legs mkha' khyab tu 'bar zhing brtan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyun gyi nyams len khyer bde ba bzhugs so// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed thun mong du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar bdun nam gsum bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon thugs kar mtheb srin gyi phyag rgyas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i utpal bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// zhes pa nas/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstod/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig de'i mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā/ re/ tut/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ tām̐ yig gi mthar/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru/ zhes pas bskor ba sngags phreng rnams kha dog dkar po las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas/ lus phyi nang thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang bar bsams nas/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa long skabs dang bstun pa ci 'grub bzlas rjes gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs kyang bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni sbyangs stobs sogs yon tan du mas rgyud phyug pa drung pa dpal ldan bzang po bas rgyun gyi nyams len khyer bde ba zhig dgos zhes pa'i bka' nan ma chog pa'i zhal ngor/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku gcig pu khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas kyi zhabs rdul spyi gtsug gis mchod pa/ bka' 'bangs thams cad kyi yang mthar gyur pa rgyal khams pa'i bande dbang phyug rab brtan gyis sbyar ba rje bla ma'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tā rā yai/ ston mchog thams cad mkhyen pa sgrol ma'i zhabs// ngag gi dbang phyug mya ngan med pa'i dpal// lo chen ba ri grub dbang gle nag pa// bshes gnyen sgre pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zla 'od gzhon nu tshul khrims snying po dang*// shes rab byang chub dwags po 'dul ba 'dzin// 'bri gung gling pa dam chos gling pa'i zhabs// chos kyi tshul khrims rnams la= /lha lung pa dang rje btsun thog gnas pa// chos kyi dbang phyug byang chub bzang po dang*// bkra shis rnam rgyal bsod nams lha dbang dang*// dpal ldan rgyal mtshan rnams la= /phyogs las rnam rgyal tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dpal// dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba// bsod nams mchog grub rnams la= /mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub zhabs// tshe mtha' yas dngos rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan// yi dam sgrol ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan tshe sbyin ma'i// lha sngags ting 'dzin zab mos rgyud smin cing*// skyabs sems tshogs gnyis sngon 'gro legs goms nas// bskyed rdzogs dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /phyogs las rnam rgyal 'od zer drug sbrags gur// gzhom bral srung 'khor nang du 'phags ma'i sku// snang stong 'gyur med bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin mthus// 'chi bdag bdud bzhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal shog /ces gsol ba btab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la// bdag dang 'gro ba byang chub bar// skyabs su mchi'o byang chen mchog /thob phyir sgrol dkar bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ skad cig rang nyid 'phags ma'i skur// gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las// 'od 'phros bla ma 'od dpag med// sgrol ma 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// zhes tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas/

gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs 'bul// sdig bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor bskul bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge 'dis 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /lan gsum/ tshogs zhing mnyes nas rang la thim// rang lus gnas yul brtan g.yo'i dngos// sgyu ma rmi lam ji bzhin du// gdod nas mi dmigs stong par gyur// zhes tshogs gnyis bsags pas sangs rgyas kyi rgyu bsgrubs la 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa ni/ chos dbyings ngang las pam̐ pad dkar// de steng a las zla rgyas steng*// tām̐ dkar de las 'od 'phros pas// 'phags pa'i tshogs mchod sdig sgrib sbyangs// 'khor 'das snod bcud tshe g.yang bsdus// tshur 'dus tām̐ la thim 'od zhu// rang nyid rgyal ba kun gyi yum// tshe sbyin sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku// ston zla 'bum 'od bzhin du dkar// gzhon nu bcu drug lang tshos sgeg /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen brgyan// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin 'dod dgu stsol// phyag g.yon thugs kar mtheb srin gyis// dus gsum sangs rgyas mtshon byed pa'i// utpal rgyas pa'i rtsa ba 'dzin// dbu skra mthon mthing lan bu mchog /ltag par thor cog zar bu 'phyangs// dar dkar stod g.yogs dar dmar po'i// sham thabs kyis mdzes skyil krung bzhugs// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyab yol can// 'dzum zhing zhi la spyan gsum g.yo// phyag zhabs chu skyes dmar po'i khrod// bung ba dang mtshungs ye shes spyan// dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'gro la gzigs// de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon dang*// thugs kar zla steng tām̐ dkar po// de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin nas// dus gsum rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// ma lus deng 'dir gshegs su gsol// zag med mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la thim// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha// bla ma rigs lnga bde gshegs yum// byang sems khro bos nam mkha' gang*// tshur gshegs kun bzang mchod pas mchod// bdag la dbang bskur dngos grub stsol// gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas// dbang bskur chu yis sku lus gang*// sgrib gnyis dri ma bag chags dag

/rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dbang thob// spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med// nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od can// longs spyod rdzogs skus dbur brgyan gyur// ces yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis lhar bsgoms la/ mchod pa ni/ dus gsum dge tshogs las grub pa'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas sgra// kun bzang mchod sprin lta bus mchod// bstod pa ni/ gang zhig mtshan tsam dran gyur pas// 'khor mtsho 'jigs pa las sgrol zhing*// mchog thun dngos grub myur stsol ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma khyod la bstod// ces bstod nas lha sku snang stong dbyer med la sems 'dzin zhi lhag zung 'jug gi lha bsgoms la mnyam gzhag ci nus bya/ des dub cing ngal na tshe sgrub srung 'khor bzlas dmigs gsal 'debs ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi// chos 'khor rtsibs brgyad mu khyud lnga// lte bar tām̐ yig mdun du oṃ// rgyab tu hā yig mtha' skor du// ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dang*// dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku rus bskor// de phyir rtsibs brgyad re re'i steng*// tā re tuttā re tu re swā// mu khyud nang ma dbyangs yig dkar// g.yon skor de'i phyir gsal byed dkar// g.yas su bskor zhing de'i phyi rol// rten 'brel snying po g.yas skor dkar// de rgyab rdo rje sngon po'i phyed// 'od zer lnga phreng g.yas skor 'phro// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar babs// thugs ka'i tshe 'khor gsal bar dmigs// de las 'od 'phros sku lus gang*// nad gdon sbyangs nas phyir 'phros pas// sku yi phyi rol steng 'og mthar// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sbubs stong dkar// rno ngar shugs drag g.yas skor 'khor// ye shes me rlung 'bar bar gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i tshe 'khor las// 'od zer dkar ser dmar sngo ljang*// mchin kha'i mdog can rim bzhin 'phros// lus gang zhi rgyas dbang drag dang*// phrin las sna tshogs myur 'grub cing*// byin rlabs dngos grub brtan par byas// sku yi ba spu'i bu ga nas// phyi rol rim bzhin spros pa yis// 'khor lo'i phyi rol 'dom gang tsam// rim par 'od gur sgo nga'i dbyibs// dkar po ser po dmar po dang*// sngon po ljang gu mchin kha'i mdog

/sra brtan gzhom bral rdo rje'i khams// dri med nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// bar mtshams utpal gsar pa'i phreng*// dri bsung dngar po 'phro ba yis// phyogs mtshams steng 'og ma lus khyab// snang stong zung 'jug ngang du dmigs// zhes gsal bar bsgom zhing gur khang re re nas sems 'dzin/ de nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma rigs bdag mchog /tshe dpag med mgon dkar dmar mdangs// phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// de yi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las// 'od zer dpag med phyogs bcur 'phros// rang gi bla tshe yar ba dang*// snod bcud 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i// tshe dpal bsod nams gzi mdangs tshogs// 'od zer rnam par tshur bsdus nas// phyag gi tshe bum nang du zhugs// 'chi med bdud rtsir khol zhing zhu// kha nas lud pas tshe chu'i rgyun// spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs te// sku lus thams cad mer gyis gang*// thugs 'khor las kyang bdud rtsi dang*// sngags 'bru'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas// sku gang nad gdon sdig sgrib dang*// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dag /rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes kyi// mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur// ces dmigs la rlung ro bsal// 'jam rlung bum pa can ci nus pa bzung la/ rdo rjes bzlas pa ni/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā// zhes brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ dus gsum dge tshogs las grub pa'i// sogs gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ bar/ ka kha ga gha nga nas/ ha kṣa bar lan gsum re/ ye dharmā lan gsum gyis dngos grub brtan par bya/ rjes ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las// 'od 'phros khams gsum snod bcud khyab// 'od zhu tshur 'dus rim gyis thim// tām̐ yig nyid kyang 'ja' ltar yal// spros bral chos dbyings ngang du gyur// slar yang srung 'khor sra brtan nang*// rang nyid yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku// rdo rje gsum dngos gsal bar gyur// zhes rtag chad mtha' bsal/

bsnyen dus gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dkar gtor zlum po rgyan ldan chu gtsang gis sbyangs pa'i mdun du mchod pa bcas legs par bshams la// oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis byin brlab/ spyan 'dren ma byas kyang chog pas/ lho phyogs po ta la nas sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la thugs rjes dgongs bzhin du bzhugs pas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa tī ma hā sa twa sarba buddha a ba lo ki te/ mā bi lamba/ mā bi lamba i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas/ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi padmo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral du gsol// 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma las pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// spro zhing nus na cha gsum gtor ma gtang ba'i phyag len kyang mdzad/ bsdu na mi dgos shing gshegs gsol mi mdzad/ dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis smon lam gang rgyas mdzad/ thun mtshams kun tu/ gzugs snang thams cad yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur gsal btab/ sgra thams cad yi ge bcu pa'i gdangs/ dran rig thams cad bde stong brjod bral 'od gsal ngang du bzhag la rtog pa'i rjes mi 'brang*/

de lta bu'i ngang nas sātstsha 'debs/ tshe mdo/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal/ maṇḍal/ gtor ma sogs la brtson par mdzad bzhin pas bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig sogs mthar sbyin sreg 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa ltar gnang ba legs/ de ltar tshe sgrub srung 'khor shin tu zab pa tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo zhes dngos grub myur ba'i mthar thug pa'i sgrub thabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab kyi don bsdus pa bklags chog ma lta bur/ rje btsun 'phags ma nyid kyi rnam 'phrul rgyal yum dbang mo mchog gi thugs dam nyams bzhes su dgos tshul bka' phebs pa ltar/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rmor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bangs/ 'a zhwa'i rigs skyes bya bral rgyal khams pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis mi shes bzhin du sku tshe sring ba'i rten 'brel kho nar dmigs nas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog gsang sngags pho brang du sbyar bar nyes par gyur gang mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol lo// ā yuḥpuṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying por bsdus pa nag 'gros bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ārya tā rā yai/ zla shel padmo bzhad pa'i lte ba la// zla ba zhun ma'i yid 'phrog lang tsho can// zla zhal mthong bas dga' bde'i dpal ster mas// zla ba'i chu rgyun bdud rtsis ring du skyobs// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub par byed pa'i thabs chos zab pa tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun du grags pa'i nyams len snying por bsdus te rgyun tu nyams su len 'dod pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/ skyabs yul zhing khams yongs su dag pa'i dbus su ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gi sdong po'i steng padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/

mdun gyi 'dab ma la sgrol dkar sogs yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas thub pa'i dbang po sogs sprul sku'i rnams/ rgyab tu gsung rab pusti brtsegs pa/ g.yon du nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs dge 'dun/ gzhan yang skyabs yul rnams kyis dpag bsam shing gi yal ga lo ma me tog gi khrod thams cad gang ba la dmigs nas bdag gzhan thams cad lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nyer gcig sogs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na ma ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas utpal dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i brdar rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus kyi me tog kha bye ba/ g.yas 'bras bu/ g.yon gang bu'i rnam par yod pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun mnga' ba/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor can/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dza/ zhes pas spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// utpal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ lha'i sku snang stong dbyer med la sems gtad de ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ tā re tuttā re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru re yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud nang ma la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa g.yon skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/

ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tunte ṣānta thā ga tohya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa/ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod par bsam/ de nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu g.yas skor du 'khor ba/ me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs gnod byed thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi sol mal du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul tshig par bsam/ yang snying ga'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'khor lo'i phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dkar po'i gur khang du gyur/ zhi ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ser po gser zhun ma lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dkar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ser po'i gur khang du gyur/ rgyas pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/

yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po bye ru'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ser po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dmar po'i gur khang du gyur/ dbang gi phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dmar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mthing ga'i gur khang du gyur/ drag po'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ljang gu margad zhun ma'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig char du 'grub par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od mthing ga'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ljang gu'i gur khang du gyur/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mchin kha 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ljang gu'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mchin kha'i gur khang du gyur/ byin rlabs dang phrin las thams cad brtan par bsam/ 'od kyi gur khang drug po thams cad kyang dbyibs sgo nga'i rnam pa lta bu dum bu gcig tu gyur pa sra zhing mkhregs pa/ bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa/ bar mtshams thams cad utpal sngon po me tog kha bye ma thag pa gsar zhing mnyen lcug dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par bsam/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba nas bzung 'od zer mchin kha'i gur khang gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong gi ngang du mnyam par 'jog de bzhin du phyi nas rim bzhin du thugs ka'i tām̐ yig gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog
