de nas spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bum nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsams la/ rlung bum pa can nyer gcig gam bdun nas gsum gyi bar du 'dzin/ de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis khengs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad byang zhing dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer yod par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ dmigs pa nam mi gsal ba'i dus snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi 'bebs shing 'od zer spro bsdu'i tshig gong bzhin brjod la/ sngags dang dmigs pa sprad de ye ma yengs par bzlas pa'i rjes su sngar ltar mchod bstod dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ā li kā li ye dharmā yig brgya rnams tshar gsum res byin rlabs brtan zhing lhag chad kha bskang*/ de nas thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas 'od mchin kha'i gur khang la thim/

de 'od ljang gu'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od mthing ga'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od dmar po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od ser po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od dkar po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'khor lo'i gur khang la thim/ de rang rje btsun mar gsal ba la thim/ de thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de tām̐ yig la thim/ de'i khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsams la/ ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag rtog pa 'phro na/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sogs kyis smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do// de ltar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa/ kha che paṇḍi ta shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ste/ bod yul du brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba bzhi tsam byon pa'i man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa/ gtso che ba ba ri ba'i slob brgyud bla ma gle nag pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa la gnang ba'i nyams len ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud dang bcas pa 'di ni tshe sgrub kyi man ngag la zab pa'i mthar thug par grags so// zhes tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe sgrub khyad par can 'od zer drug sbrags ma rgyun du nyams su len tshul tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung lhan cig tu bkod cing sogs khong rnams kyang nag 'gros dkyus gcig tu bris pa 'di yang gnyer dbon bsod nams mchog ldan nas ngos kyi rim gror dgon khag sogs su sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub 'dzug 'dun la yig cha zhal gsal can dgos zhes bskul ngor sa skya pa kun blos mgyogs par sbyar ba dge/

sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i snang ba yis// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes sbyin mdzad pa// 'chi med 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yis// 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston mchog stsol cig /gang de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i// sgrub cing mchod pa'i zla shel ni// phun tshogs tshe dang blo gros kyi// bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho rgyas phyir 'chad// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang man ngag gi rgyun legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag gis rang gzhan gyi phan bde'i dga' ston spel ba'i slad du gnas gtsang zhing yid dang mthun par rje btsun ma'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rigs kyi mdun/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi dbus su maṇḍa lar rdul tshon gyis padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i lte bar zla gdan la tshom bu dkar po gcig bkod/ de'i g.yas su rin po che'i bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa/ g.yon du rje btsun mar 'bul gtor dkar zlum/ mdun du byang shar nas brtsams te gtor ma cha gsum dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs sta gon bya/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po bdag bskyed ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ thog mar mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams lam gyis gsal btab nas/ de dag gi gsang gsum gyi yon tan yid la dran bzhin du brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam rim gyi smon lam dang bcas pa bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas byin gyis brlab/ dharmā ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin dbab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyi sgrub thabs ji lta ba bzhin la/ bla ma dang sbyin bdag sogs kyi ched du yin na dmigs pa'i khyad par/ thugs srog tām̐ yig gi klad kor nang du bla ma/ khog par bsgrub bya'i gtso bo dang*/ mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon sogs su bsgrub bya gzhan rnams ngo bo de ka yin pa la/ rnam pa gzhon tshul lang tsho rgyas shing gos rgyan sogs phun sum tshogs par bsgom/ tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs pa grub nas/ ngo bo bsgrub bya la rnam pa rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga gyen 'greng lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa re rer gsal btab/ rang dang bsgrub bya'i sems gnyis ka'i ngo bo blo 'das brjod bral du shes par byas la 'dzin med du 'jog go /gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po tshom bu lhar bskyed cing bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sngar ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig rnams dor/ de nas rdo rje dril bu spos bcas 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs shlau ka gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra e hye he/ zhes pas spyan drangs te nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// sogs nas/

'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hās mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis sku khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs nas/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ nai wi dya'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā be sha āḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pas dgug gzhug bcing zhing mnyes par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes pa'i tshab tu/ 'di la zhes bsgyur ba tsam khyad par ro// de nas/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo nas/ 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes la sogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ sngags yi ge bcu pa spel tshig dang bcas pa ci nus bzla/ tshe sgrub dmigs bsal byed na/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dpag med nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te phyag gi bum pa'i nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pa dang*/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang*/
'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/

'di skabs bsgrub bya gsal 'debs tshul mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar bsgom na'ang rung mod/ yig cha gzhan las bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar du zla ba'i gdan la bsgrub bya nyid gos rgyan gzab 'phyor phun sum tshogs pas mdun bskyed la gdong phyogs te gus pa'i tshul gyis 'khod par bsam zhes 'byung ba ltar dmigs kyang legs shing*/ bum bskyed skabs kyang de gnyis gang ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ rang dang bsgrub bya'i spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer yod par bsams la sngags bzla/ 'dir 'od zer drug sbrags kyi dmigs pa yongs rdzogs mdun bskyed la sbyar ba'i tshul kyang snang ba/ de ltar na/ rang gi phyi rol du sogs la mdun bskyed kyi phyi rol tu sogs dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od dkar po 'phros sogs dang*/ rang dang bsgrub bya'i lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sogs kyis mtshon tshig gi kha bsgyur tshul rigs 'gre sbyar dgos par snang na'ang*/ zhwa lu ba sogs kyi yig char de lta bu'i dmigs bsal mi snang bas 'dir ma bris la/ spro na 'gal ba med par sems/ ā li kā li ye dharmā yig brgya rnams lan gsum res lhag chad kha bskang zhing dngos grub brtan par bya/ mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa bum bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa ni bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i steng rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa bzhag bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/

lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshigs dor/ bdag la zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di la zhes bsgyur/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ bum nang gi lha yi thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po sogs nas/ g.yas skor du yod pa/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha yi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing gzungs thag nas gzung ste/ sngags spel tshig can stong phrag sogs bzlas mthar gzungs thag bsdu/ spro na/ slar yang bum pa'i lha yi spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dpag med sogs gong bzhin tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs bzlas kyang bya/ yig brgya dang dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams tshar gsum re'i mthar gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa mdun bum thun mong du mchod bstod dang mdun bskyed la gtor ma 'bul ba ni mar me la sogs pa sbar nas/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin la/ thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// tshe dang ye shes stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ me tog

bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod cing*/ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo dbul/ spro na rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga rnams spyi ltar sbyar bas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs nas// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas sogs gsol ba gdab/ yi ge zhwa lu mkhan chen gyis 'di ltar mdzad snang ba rjes gnang sogs kyi tshe 'di kho na 'thad cing*/ gzhan rjes chog gi bzod gsol rjes su phul kyang chog brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam la dung chos kyi chu bum 'dir ye shes pa gshegs pa rgyud sde 'og ma spyir btang ltar byas kyi/ dkon mchog lhun grub sogs kyi yig char dam ye dbyer med du 'od zhu mdzad pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// nang du phul/ gtor ma rnams chab gtsang mas bran te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha yi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlab/ gtor ma dang po nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na ma sarba buddha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa ga wa tī mahā satwa sarba buddha a ba lo ki te/ mā bi lamba mā bi lamba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/

rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma lhag ma rnams cha gsum gyi cho gas btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gso/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar bzhin la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ dharma ra ṇi tas mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes la sogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ zhag grangs sbrel nas byed na/ nyin snga ma rnams su/ phyogs bcu na sogs nas/ bye brag tu tshom bu'i rten 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ grol rgyu'i thun tha ma la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyis tshom bu'i ye shes gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ gang ltar yang*/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo ba dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas me tog gi char sil ma dgram zhing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams ye shes kyis// 'chi med grub pa'i dge mtshan brnyes 'dod na// 'chi med yid bzhin 'khor lo 'di sten dang*// 'chi med go 'phang thob par gdon mi za// de skad sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye shes sku// khyab bdag bla ma'i thugs rje'i bdud rtsi yis// mos gus padmo'i dga' tshal dar babs pas// rang dang skal mnyam gzhan la phan phyir gdams// gang las byung ba'i legs byas snang ba yis// srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba kun bsal nas// tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das// 'chi med mgon de'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga'i ngag 'don snying por bris pa 'di yang*/ gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang*/ zhwa lu mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub sogs lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa rnams kyi gsung gi snang ba la brten nas rang gzhan mang por phan pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa bdun las chos tshul 'di'i bka' drin mang du thos pa'i rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos skyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga gsal bar bkod pa 'chi med grub pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dran pas tshe dang ye shes mchog ster ba'i// bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gus btud nas// gang de'i thun mong min pa'i rjes gnang tshul// 'chi med grub pa'i bdud rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ stegs kyi khar mañdzi'i steng du maṇḍa lar padma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla gdan la tshom bu dkar po gcig bkod/ mdun du gtor ma dkar zlum dang*/ cho ga rgyas pa ltar na cha gsum yang bsham/ mtha' skor du mtshams 'dzin me tog dang bcas pa'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ bum pa bcud ldan/ me tog gi snod/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇḍal me tog sogs sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/

dang po ni/ rgyas par spro na sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gtor ma cha gsum gyi bar nyams su blang*/ de tsam mi nus na/ thog mar brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis brlab/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyi sgrub thabs ltar bya/ mdun bskyed tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba/ zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di la zhes bsgyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo dbul/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha yi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/

na massa manta buddha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa tī mahā sa twa/ sarba buddha a ba lo ki te/ mā bi lamba/ mā bilamba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po sogs nas/ 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes la sogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur par bsams la sngags spel tshig can ci nus bzlas mthar gong bzhin gsol ba btab/ bum pa'i khar dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i steng gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po sogs nas/ bstod pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin bya/ bum nang gi lha yi thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo sogs nas/ 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha yi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa dang*/

sku'i cha shas thams cad nas kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam la/ sngags spel tshig can stong phrag gcig bzla/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes dkon mchog lhun grub sogs kyi yig char dam ye dbyer med 'od zhu mdzad snang*/ gzhan rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la 'di bzhin no// pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing dung chos kyi chu bum nang du phul/ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ dbang gis smin cing snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul te rang rang gi gral la snyims pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems cad thams cad kyi don du/ sogs kun slong dang kun spyod gsal 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyi gtam ci rigs pa dang*/ bshad bya'i chos mdo sngags kyi bye brag rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu sogs ji ltar 'tshams pa bshad rjes/ lo rgyus kyi khyad par/ da lam 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ chos spyod dbang po thul ba ni// 'khor ba ru ni ji srid gnas// de srid bsod nams la sogs tshogs// byang chub sgrub byed rab tu skye// 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni// ci yang yod pa ma mthong ste// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba slu ba kun tu spyad// ces gsungs pa ltar chos sgrub pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul lhur len pa shin tu gal che ba yin zhing*/ de la'ang*/ lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin// nor bu sman sogs phyi yin te// rnal 'byor nus pa nang gi'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi nor bu rin po che'i rigs dang bcud len gyi sman sbyor sogs la brten pa dang*/

nang rnal 'byor pa'i bsam gtan gyi nus pas tshe sring ba'i thabs gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir nang gi rnal 'byor mchog tu gyur pa mtshan 'dzin pa'am/ sku'i snang brnyan dran pa tsam gyis kyang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes sogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa la brten nas mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang dka' ba med par 'thob nus pa'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can/ bya rgyud padma'i rigs kyi yum du gtogs pa rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i skor yin/ de la'ang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags nas rim par brgyud pa'i sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags zhes thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo 'bul ba'i skabs yin/ de la'ang thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad cig snyan du gsol na/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul gyi cho ga ma lus pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po zhig mdzad pa las/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs tshul 'di nyid kyang byung ba yin zhing*/ 'di'i man ngag rnams slob dpon nyid la sgrol mas dngos su gnang skad/ de la rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma rdo rje gdan pas gsan/ sgrub thabs kyang mang du mdzad/ de la snying rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i rnam 'phrul thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis gsan/ sgrub thabs mang po bod du bsgyur/ de la bla ma gle nag pas gsan/ sgrub pa lo drug tu mdzad pas mngon sum du zhal gzigs te chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes/

'dis jo bo rje las brgyud pa'i man ngag kyang spyan snga rin po che las gsan zhes lo rgyus kha cig las 'byung*/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa rin po ches gsan pa yin te/ khong gis dang por thos bsam mdzad pa'i dus su la stod stag ri ba yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa gcig la lag ris bstan pas/ jo bo btsun pa khyod la chos kyi las 'phro gsha' ma gcig 'dug pa la tshe la long mi 'dug ste/ lo gsum las mi thub par 'dug zer ba dang*/ sngar nas khong rang gi rmi lam du ltas ngan yang yang byung ba gnyis 'dzom pas/ tshe 'di la thugs gsha' ma rang byung ste lo gcig thub bam ci tsam thub thub kyi tshe lhag ma 'di la chos lag len gsha' mar thebs pa cig bya/ de la thog mar gdams ngag khyad par can ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen cig btsal dgos dgongs nas gsan pa 'phro bcad nas dbus su byon pa'i lam khar gzhu'i mkhar gong du bla ma gle nag pa dang mjal nas lo rgyus byas pas/ byang chub sgrub pa la lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i thabs khyad par can nga la yod kyi ston pa khyod thugs bde 'bol gyis thong zhig gsungs nas 'di'i sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnang*/ da khyod kyis gzhan du ma 'gro bar 'di rang du sdod la sgoms shig gsungs nas/ lung pa de rang gi lung lag mkhar lung bya ba cig gi phur sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas zla ba bcu gcig lon tsa na rje btsun mas zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas khyod kyis lo drug cu tsam thub/ sems can la phan thogs par 'ong gsungs/ de nas phyis dgung lo drug cu lon pa'i dus su rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ nga'i sku cig bzhengs dang lo bcu tsam sdod par 'dug gi gsungs nas ras bris cig bzhengs skad/ dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa'i dus su gsol ba btab pas yang nga'i sku gcig bzhengs dang lo bcu thub par 'dug gsungs nas lugs ma cig bzhengs skad/

sku de gnyis byin rlabs che bar grags te/ ras bris de phyis ra sgreng na bzhugs skad/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i dus su rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ da rung nga yi sku cig bzhengs na lo mang du thub par 'dug gsungs pa la/ khong rang gi bzhugs sa'i mdun gyi gyang logs la ri mo cig bzhengs skad/ de nas lo bco lnga'i bar du bzhugs te/ yongs su rdzogs pa dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa lngar bzhugs par grags so// 'dis spyan snga rin po che las jo bo nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa rdzogs par gsan pas brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis 'dres su gyur/ de la ston mchog thub pa'i dbang pos ma 'ongs pa na ri brag tshang tshing can du chos smra ba'i dge slong 'tsho byed ces 'byung zhes lung bstan pa'i sa gsum na mnyam med sgam po pa bsod nams rin chen gyis gsan te/ rje de nyid kyis dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa'i dus su sgrub pa mdzad pas rtogs pa khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs na'ang*/ mkha' 'gros sku tshe'i tshad lo gsum las med par lung bstan pas/ rgyal khams su ro snyoms kyi spyod pa la byon pa na e nas mar phebs pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa dang mjal bas/ khong na re/ khyed skyes bu dam pa cig tu 'dug pas sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par 'dug gi gsungs pas/ bla ma sgam po pas/ nga la sems can gyi don bya ba'i long med/ mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan la da tshe lo gsum las med gsungs pa byung ba'i tshul zhus pas/ dge bshes sgre ba'i zhal nas/ 'o na nga la des mi gnod pa'i thabs yod kyi/ ro khung brus kyang a'u rtsi/ rkang lag 'thor yang a'u rtsi/ 'chi rtags tshang yang a'u rtsi ba'i gdams ngag jo mo sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bya ba'i gdams pa khyad pa can zhig yod kyi gsungs nas 'di gnang bas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lngar bsrings te phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/

des rang gi sras kyi thu bo rje sgom pa tshul khrims snying por gnang ba nas rim par brgyud pa sogs/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rab gsal gyi rnam par 'phrul pa gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho la bka' bab cing*/ de nyid kyis snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bstan pa'i srog shing 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la gnang ba nas bzung ste/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i bar du lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid thugs nyams su bzhes shing dngos grub brnyes pa sha stag tu byon pa dang*/ gzhan yang brgyud srol 'di la kha che paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra nas brgyud pa dang*/ gnyan lo dar ma grags nas brgyud pa rnams kyang don gyis 'dus pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon gyi bya ba brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya ba dang*/ mdun gyi tshom bu bcom ldan 'das mar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul gyis bskyed cing mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa bya ba/ bum pa bsgrub pa sogs sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i rim pa maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar slob dpon la rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas phyag snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs nas/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung chen po 'thibs pa bzhin mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'grub par shog /ces rgyud dag par byas nas/ slar yang khyad par gyi don zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ bdag gi dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ slob dpon la rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po dung pa zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/

der ma zad rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams rje btsun sgrol ma nas/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor can gyi sku can du lam gyis gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa nas/ 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu g.yas skor du 'khor ba me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs gnod byed thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi so mal du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul du tshig pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang snying ga'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po sogs nas/ zhi ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sogs bdag bskyed bzhin la gong gi rigs 'gres tshig kha bsgyur dang bcas te/ gsar zhing mnyen lcug dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la mos gus drag po dung pa zhig byas pas slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs rgyud bskul te de rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyi gnas nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs shing 'chi med bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i rnam pa nam mkha' gang bar byon pa dang lhan cig tu/

mdun bskyed dang slob dpon las kyang de 'dra ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa chad de khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo rnams nas thogs med du zhugs te/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo la sib sib thim pas de las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa skya chil chil babs/ lus thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khengs pas/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs kyis dag tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang yon tan la sogs pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur pa'i thugs mos brtan po gnang bar zhu/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ ā be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod spos rol bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas bskur byed nam mkha'i lha tshogs spyan drangs pa la khyed rang rnams kyis yan lag bzhi pa sgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan/ slob dpon gyis/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rnams rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i skur bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid la mnga' dbul gyi slad du me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ nai bi dya āḥhūm̐/ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ las rdor gyis mchod pa stob pa'i tshul bya/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas me tog 'thor bzhin du/ phun sum tshogs pa nas/ bkra shis gsum pa'o// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ltar na rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku yi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ gnas skabs su lus lha yi skur bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du thugs mos mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ thog mar rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar sngar gsal btab bzhin pa'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa de nyid slar yang dran par byas te/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig mdzad pa la brten nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng rnams dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ba zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng rnams dang bcas pa la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de nas spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bum pa'i nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang*/ 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis khengs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer yod pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par zhu/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dang*/ slar yang 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos kyang lan gsum gsum re mdzad par zhu/ a ā sogs nas/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga nas/ ha kṣaḥ/ ye dharmā nas/ shra ma ṇaḥ de ltar bzlas pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing dbyer med du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa dang bcas te/

slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gsung gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// de ltar na rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyis ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ gnas skabs su ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gsung dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi tām̐ yig la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad pas/ de las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de thams cad lan tshwa chur bcug pa bzhin 'od du zhu nas 'od mchin kha'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od ljang gu'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od mthing ga'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od dmar po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od ser po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od dkar po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'khor lo dkar po'i gur khang la thim/ de rang rje btsun mar gsal ba la thim/ de thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de tām̐ yig la thim/ de'i khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur pa la brten nas 'khor 'das gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i gnas lugs 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te de'i ngang la blo lhod kyis glod de cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar na rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyis yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ gnas skabs su yid 'od gsal gyi ye shes su bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du thugs mos mdzod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams skad cig gis sgrol ma dkar mo'i skur lam gyis gsal ba la sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs de rnams brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing bden pa'i tshig gis kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ de rnams kyis rjes su gnang ba'i dngos gzhi legs par grub nas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa zab gsang snyan brgyud kyi tshul du bzhugs pa nyid legs par phul grub pa yin pas/ 'di'i sgo nas kyang rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa kha gso/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin la/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod don gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang*/ badzra muḥs tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs bsngo smon dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs shis pa brjod pas me tog gi char sil ma dgram/

las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// brgya tshar sogs mdzad na/ thog ma de la 'di kha sor bzhag dang*/ gnyis pa man chad la maṇḍal sa gzhi spos byugs dang*/ gsol gdab bstod pa gnyis tshar gcig gi rjes su 'di yi khyad par gyi gsol gdab sbrel ba las rgyun bshags mi dgos/ bzlas lung sngags gsum gsum mdzad/ gzhan dkyus bzhin mdzad pa phyag len yin no// de ltar 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi// thun mong min pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i tshul// 'chi med grub pa'i bdud rtsis lus can kun// tshe dang ye shes padmo rgyas gyur cig /ces sgrol ma dkar mo thun mong ma yin pa 'od zer drug sbrags kyis rjes su gnang ba'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang thun mong pa'i yig cha la/ snyan brgyud zhal shes kyi zin tho rnams kyis brgyan te rje bla ma rnams kyis ji ltar phyag len mdzad pa la gzhi byas/ tshig gi mtha' bskyed tshul mi 'gal bas zur brgyan te nyams su blang bde bar/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong*/ 'jam mgon bla ma byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ zab rgyas gdams pa'i gter mdzod rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ngag dbang legs sgrub rnams las tshul 'di'i bka' drin ci rigs pa thob cing*/ gzhan yang nges par thams cad mkhyen pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ rje bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas sogs las sgrol ma dkar mo'i chos tshul mang du thos pa'i rgyal khams nyul ba'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas zab gsang snyan brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dpe 'di tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud 'dzin las gzhan la bka' rgya dam par bya ba gces so//
༈ /rje btsun sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge bde ldan mgon po'i zhal lung ring 'tsho'i bsil sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// phun tshogs ring

shis par brjod pa'i rgyan/ por 'tsho ba'i gson skyen nyer stsal zhing*// srog 'phrog la sogs dkar min bya ba rab spangs pas// byis blos bgrang bas 'dzad min tshe tshad la dbang ba// bla ma bde ldan mgon po'i shis pas skyongs shig kye// mtshan dngos po'i dpe/ dpe'i cha rdzogs 'dzum zhal kun phan ltar// cung zad gdangs pa'i mchu sgros bimba bzhin// 'gro la gzigs pa'i spyan bdun utpa la'i// rjes 'gro mnga' ba yid bzhin 'khor los skyongs// thar 'dod nges pa'i dpe/ yongs kyi ded dpon tshar pa rje// gsang rgyud man ngag kun gyi gter gyur pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rjes su 'gro las gzhan// dper 'os srid na med phyir dad phyag brtsegs// dri bcas 'gal ba'i gzugs can/ mtho ris lam nas ma phabs shing*// gdug can drang srong lto bar bzung min pa'i// snyan brgyud gaṅgās 'tsho ba bung ba'i rgyu// mtha' dag sbyangs pa'i tshul 'di rmad kyi chos// gdams rdzas bkod pa thog ma'i gsal byed pa'i zin bris nyung gsal rtogs sla zhing*// zlos dang ma tshang med cing rang bzo'i dris// bslad pa min sogs khyad chos mang ldan pa// grub gnyis gsos su sbyin gyis dga' bas longs// de yang bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dis pa'i mdza' bshes ston mchog zas gtsang sras pos gsang chen 'bras bu'i theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas dus min 'chi ba las ldog cing ring 'tsho'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs tshul mang du gsungs kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ lus dang ngag gi las kyi phyi// bsam gtan las kyi nang gi yin// nor bu sman sngags phyi yi ste// rnal 'byor nus pa nang yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi rol bcud len sogs rdzas dang rten 'brel gto thabs tsam gyi ngal ba la ma ltos par/ nang gi rnal 'byor bsam gtan kho na gtso bor bton cing*/

bzlas brjod dang zung du 'brel pa rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gdams pa la bod yul du brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig byung yang*/ 'dir skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa gtso che zhing*/ jo bo chen po rje dang*/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ gnyan lo dar ma grags nas brgyud pa rnams kyang don gyis tshang bar bzhed pa/ kun gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i gdams pa zab pa'i mthar thug pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ de'i dang po la'ang*/ lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro dang*/ lam dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed gnyis las/ dang po la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ de'i dang po la gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ phan yon dang*/ bslab bya ste drug las/ dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su khrus byas bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sems gzhan du mi 'phro ba'i tshul gyis/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs gnas khang sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang las baiḍūrya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa/ tha gru yangs shing rgya che ba/ mnan na nem byed cing*/ bteg na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba skyed pa/ steng na 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim phub cing*/ me tog gi char 'bebs pa ste zhing khams yongs su dag pa'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi shing lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rtser padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar dbus su rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/

rnam pa bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i tshul can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis sngar gyi gdan de 'dra ba chung ngu re re'i steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can dang*/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la rje btsun ma gtso bor gyur pa'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma la rnam snang sogs longs sku'i cha byad can dang*/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la sogs pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can te sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ rgyab kyi 'dab ma la ngo bo skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa rtogs pa'i yon tan yin yang*/ rnam pa gsung rab glegs bam brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu dam sa le/ gdong dar khra bun ne yod pa ni chos dkon mchog dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa can rnams dang*/ mtha' skor kun tu yal 'dab kyi khrod rnams su yang mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha grub pa rig 'dzin sogs skyabs gnas su 'os so cog thams cad kyang sprin phung gtibs pa tsam bsgom pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog yin/ gnyis pa ni/ de rnams kyi mdun ngos su rang nyid/ g.yas su tshe 'di'i pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du dgra 'dre/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa bzhin khrig mer gyis gang bar bsam/ gsum pa ni/ dad pa dang*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ snying rje gsum yin la/ de'i dang po la gsum ste/ skyabs yul rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la ngo mtshar zhing sems dang ba ni dang ba'i dad pa/

de lta bu'i go 'phang bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis thob par 'dod pa ni 'dod pa'i dad pa dang*/ skyabs yul rnams mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa la yin par ngo shes shing the tshom dang yid gnyis med pa ni yid ches kyi dad pa'o// 'jigs pa la gsum ste/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa dang*/ rang don yid byed kyis 'jigs pa dang*/ tha mal snang zhen gyis 'jigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o// snying rje skyabs 'gro'i rgyur gsungs pa ni sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod dka' bas mnar tshul la legs par bsam na shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye zhing de la brten nas sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi blo skye la/ de yang da lta rang nyid la de lta bu'i nus pa med la gzhan nyan rang dang 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams la'ang med pas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod dang*/ thob byed lam gyi rtsa ba yang skyabs 'gro nyid yin par shes nas skyabs su 'gro 'dod kyi blo skye ba ni theg chen kho na'i dbang du byas pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril te dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid spang gnyen ro gcig tu gyur te bskyab bya skyob byed dang bral bar ma gyur gyi bar du ci mdzad khyed mkhyen snyam pas blo lings kyis bkal nas rang nyid kyis byang drangs te sems can thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro gu di ri ri byed par bsam zhing tshig rjes su sems hri li li 'brangs te skyabs 'gro bzhi skor brgya stong nas grangs med par brjod/ de yang dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i tshe rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi lam sna 'dren pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe mdun gyi yi dam dang g.yas kyi sangs rgyas rnams la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi ston pa mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/

dam pa'i chos zhes pa'i tshe rgyab kyi glegs bam rnams la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi lam dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe g.yon phyogs kyi dge 'dun dang mtha' skor gyi chos skyong sogs la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pa bya/ mdor na skyabs 'gros mtshon pa'i dge sbyor thams cad sems gzhan du ma yengs ba'i ngang nas gnad du smin par bya dgos/ de las ldog na byas la ma bsags pa'i las zhes ngal ba 'bras med du gsungs pa'ang snying gi bum par bcang bar rigs so// mthar skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan zhig 'phros te sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas lus zag med 'ja' lus dang sems rtog med chos skur gyur te so so'i zhing khams su bya khyu 'phur ba bzhin song bar bsam/ slar yang mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang nas thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas mtha' skor gyi chos skyong sogs dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu nas dge 'dun la thim/ de chos la/ de sangs rgyas la/ de yi dam la/ de brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ de gtso bo la thim/ de yang dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi rtsa ba nas yar zhu ste thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin can snum la 'dril ba dmar la dngas pa zhig tu gyur te rang dang je nye je nyer byung ste spyi bo nas thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres song snyam pa yan chad kun rdzob kyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ de ga'i ngang la dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du lhod kyis glod/ tha ma rang sor zung ste/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul chad pa'i rig pa stong gsal rjen ne ba de nyid kyi steng na skyabs gnas thams cad tshang ba yin te/

gsal ba dge 'dun/ stong pa dam chos/ zung 'jug sangs rgyas/ de gsum dbyer mi phyed pa bla ma ste rim bzhin sprul longs chos sku ngo bo nyid kyi skur thag bcad nges shes bskyed de 'dzin pa ma zhugs par rgyun skyong ba ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'o// phan yon dang bslab bya ni theg pa chen po'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin nges par byas la mi 'gal bar bslab par bya'o// gnyis pa sems bskyed la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems sgom pa gnyis/ dang po la smon 'jug gnyis las/ smon pa sems bskyed pa ni/ 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re res kyang rang nyid kyi pha ma yang yang byas shing*/ byas res kyis phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa mtha' dag las skyob pa'i drin can sha stag yin/ 'di rnams 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang de sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pas la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngams po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis mig ldong*/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bus ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam la rdeg 'chos shing ngan song gsum gyi g.yang khar 'grem pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams dang*/ nyan rang la sogs pa 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa 'ga' zhig la'ang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod de/ khong gi sku las 'od zer re spros pa dang*/ chos thun re gsungs pas kyang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa 'khor ba las sgrol bar nus pas/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ci nas kyang thob par bya snyam du yang yang bsams la/

sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs brjod/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sems bskyed ni/ de lta bu'i go 'phang de yang*/ skye bo phal ba dge ba mi byed pa lta bu rgyu med pa dang*/ mu stegs byed lta bu rgyu log pa dang*/ nyan rang lta bu rgyu ma tshang ba la mi 'byung bas/ tshang la ma nor ba rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bgrod ba gcig pa'i lam theg chen thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs la ci nus kyis bslabs shing*/ khyad par rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang snyam du bsams la de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhes sogs brjod pa yan kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ gnyis pa ni sems bskyed bya skyed byed thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs par bsam pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa gnyis/ dang po la yul dag pa la brten pa dang*/ ma dag pa la brten pa gnyis/ de'i dang po la tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa dang*/ tshogs gsog pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po langs thabs su gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ khyad par tshogs zhing mthong ba la sgrib byed kyi las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas rlung sna bug g.yas nas phyir rgyu ba dang bstun 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drang*/ de yang rgyal ba rnams rang bzhin gyis gnas gsum gshegs bzhud bzhugs gsum gyi spros pa dang bral ba mkha' dbyings khyab par lhun grub 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa la 'od zer gyis phog pas gsal bar byas pa la rang bzhin gyi gnas sam chos sku'i zhing khams nas spyan drangs zhes tha snyad byas pa yin/

gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa dngos ni/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ sdom pa bzung ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang lus zhing rdul gyi grangs mnyam du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing*/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ zhes pas bla ma dang*/ na ma ārya tā re sogs kyis yi dam 'khor bcas la phyag byas par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las mchod pa'i lha mo lang tsho dar la babs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spud ba mang por sprul te/ de yang lha mo dkar mos phyag na dung phor yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu gtsang me tog dkar po dang bcas pas gang ba thogs te tshogs zhing rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul ba dang*/ lha mo dmar mos dung phor dang ril ba dang bya ma bum sogs dri bzang gis sbags pa'i chus bkang ba thogs te zhabs bsil ba dang*/ yang lha mo dkar mos thang las skyes pa dang*/ chu las skyes pa'i me tog gi bye brag mtshar zhing dri bsung dang ldan pas bkang ba'i za ma tog thogs te dbu la 'thor bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo dud khas lhan cig skyes pa dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dri zhim po'i ring bu dang spos phor sogs thogs te shangs la 'bul ba dang*/ lha mo dmar skyas nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang me shel dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ mar me'i sdong bu'i 'od kyis nyi zla yang mog mog por byed pa sogs snang gsal gyi rigs thogs te spyan lam du ngom bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo ljang gus ga bur dang*/ tsandan dang*/ gur gum sogs bsil sman sna tshogs btang ba'i chus bkang ba'i dung phor thogs te thugs kar byugs pa dang 'thor yab kyis sku la 'thor ba dang*/ lha mo dmar mos lha dang mi yi zas bzang dgu ro brgya dang ldan pas bkang ba'i rin po che'i gzhong pa sogs thogs te ljags la 'bul bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo sngon mos lha'i sil snyan dang*/ pi wang dang gling bu dang phig rdob dang rdza rnga dang rnga zlum sogs rol mo'i bye brag kun snyan lam du 'khrol pas tshogs zhing rnams kyi thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par bsams la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/

oṃ gu ru ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ bar brjod/ lha mo rnams tshur 'dus rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par bsam/ gsum pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba snying gar bzhag ste/ don yid la dran bzhin pas gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ de yang dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pas rten gyi stobs te tshogs zhing rnams so// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// zhes pas sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa drag po skyes pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dngos su bstan la/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam du sdom pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ de ltar byas pas sdig sgrib ji ltar che yang dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs gnyis shugs las bstan pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag dang*/ 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// zhes pas 'khor 'das dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med pa ni rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// zhes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bsten pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bzung ba'i yan lag dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro'i yan lag dang*/ rang gzhan don ni zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis smon pa sems bskyed dang*/ byang chub mchog gis sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi yan lag bstan te gong du bshad pa ltar ro// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas de ltar bgyis pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog cig snyam pas bsngo ba'i yan lag rnams bstan to// de ltar byas pas tshogs zhing rnams dgyes bzhin du 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag pa ni/

yul tshad med pa mkha' khyab kyi sems can la dmigs te bsam pa tshad med pa ris sam phyogs su ma lhung ba bsgom pas na tshad med dam/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gzugs khams kyi tshangs pa'am/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas la tshangs pa'i sgras bshad pa'ang 'di nyid bsgom pa las 'byung bas na tshangs pa'i gnas zhes bya ste/ sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba bcu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ de dang ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa dam bca' dang 'brel ba/ de bzhin du gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba/ de bzhin du 'gyur pa bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba ste gzhan gsum la'ang 'gre shes par byas la tshig tsam ma yin par zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa sogs brjod par bya'o// khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs sogs su 'di kho na bzhin bya yi rgyun du ni tshig res dang mthun pa smon lam dang 'brel pa tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ gcig dang du bral gyi rigs pas dpyad pa stong nyid bshig nas sgom pa dang*/ sngags kyis stong par sbyangs pa btsan thabs su sgom pa gnyis las phyi ma nyid skabs su babs te/ de la'ang snang bcas su sgom pa dang snang med du sgom pa gnyis yod pa las lha dang gzhal yas khang sgom pa'i phyogs la phyi ma nyid legs par bzhed/ de yang swa bhā wa sogs sngags brjod pa tsam gyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad nam mkha' la du ba yal ba bzhin 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam la rang sems stong pa nam mkha' gsum po ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rig stong rjen ne ba de ga'i ngang la hril gyis bsgrim/ lhod kyis glod/ rang so bzung ba spel mar byas te ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog pa ni gnad kyi don te 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam thams cad kyang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes nas zhen pa rang grol du 'gyur ba dang*/

gong 'og gi thabs kyi cha thams cad kyang shes rab dang zung 'brel du 'gyur ba dang*/ stong nyid kyi ngang las lhar bzhengs pas 'bras dus su sku gnyis phrin las dang bcas pa 'bad med lhun grub tu rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod do// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ thun mong du lha sgom pa dang*/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa'i zab khyad rnams sgom pa dang gnyis kyi/ dang po la bla ma dag gi bzhed pas bya ba can gyi bskyed rim dang*/ byed pa can gyi bskyed rim zhes rnal 'byor bla med kyi khrid gzhung chen po rnams dang 'gros mthun par mdzad kyang*/ don la yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshogs lha yi skur sgom pa dang*/ de nyid la gsal snang khyad par can skye ba'i phyir rim bzhin sems bzung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang lhar sgom sa'i thad der pam̐ yig dkar po zhig thol gyis byung ba yongs su gyur pa las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru ljang gu/ ge sar dmar ser kha bye ma thag pa lta bu/ de'i lte bar a yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa shel dkar gyi me long kha sbubs pa lta bu/ de'i steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ 'od kor can zhes pa'i bar shar sgom gyi tshul du nyams su len pa ni bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor bsam pa ni nyer sgrub kyi yan lag go /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim zhes pa'i bar ni sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs nas gsol ba gdab/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab ste dbang lha rnams kyang rigs bdag la thim par bsam pa ni sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go

/de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rang nyid la mchod par bsams la mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod mchod/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod nas lha mo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// ༈ /gnyis pa sems 'dzin gyi rim pa la/ nga rgyal la bslab pa dang*/ rnam pa la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nga ni tha mal pa nam yang ma yin te skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs 'bras dus sangs rgyas kyis mngon du mdzad kyang 'gro ba bud med kyis 'dul ba la gzigs nas shes rab lha mo'i skur bzhengs pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal tur tur po de ka la dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du de tsam du mi 'dzin par lhod kyis glod/ de ltar grim lhod ran pos shes pa rang so bzung ste 'dzin med kyi lta bas rgyas 'debs pa ni gnad dam pa yin no// gnyis pa ni bla med kyi khrid gzhung chen po rnams su rnam pa spyi dang bye brag la sems bzung ba sogs sa bcad mang du mdzad kyang*/ 'dir ni spyi yi sems 'dzin rgyas tsam las mi mdzad pas/ nga rgyal la sems bzung ba de ka'i ngang las slar yang nga nyid sgrol ma dngos yin na de yang rnam pa 'di lta bu ste/ sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltar dngas shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ mdzes sdug gi phul du byung bas drang srong rnams kyi brtan pa'ang 'phrog par nus pa/ mnyen lcug dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pa pus mo'i steng du mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas utpal dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin sbyar bas thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus kyi me tog da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams mtshon pa'i brdar kha bye ba/

g.yas kyi me tog 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mtshon pa'i brdar 'bras bu'i tshul du yod pa/ g.yon gyi me tog ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mtshon pa'i brdar gang bu ste kha ma bye ba'i tshul du yod pa/ smin mtshams su spyan dbu ma dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa yid tsam dmar po/ dkyus ring zhing zim bur gzigs pa/ spyan g.yon pa gyen du bsgangs pa lta bu/ ba mchog gi rdzi ma lta bus mdzes shing smin ma dang bcas pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi spyan gnyis kyang de dang 'dra ba/ shangs gangs ri'i zur ltar legs pa'i nang nas utpa la'i dri bsung 'thul ba snyan gnyis snyan shal ring ba/ mchu'i sgros legs shing bimpa ltar dmar ba/ ljags srab cing mnyen pa/ tshems bzhi bcu tham pa dkar zhing thags bzang ba/ zur bzhir mche ba'i myu gu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mgul pa bum pa ltar zlum zhing gnyer ma gsum dang bcas pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings pa'i lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ mkhrang zhing rgyas pa'i nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ sku stod tsho skem ran pa/ sked skabs phra ba/ sku smad shes rab kyi rang bzhin rgyas pa/ gsang ba'i padma rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho zhing mdzes pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la sha ltar 'jam pa'i dbus su spyan re re yod pa/ sor mo rnams ngang pa ltar drwa bas 'brel pa/ dbu rgyan ni prog zhu rim pa gsum can rin po che'i rtse phran nam ze prog lnga'i rtsa ba nas bai ḍūrya'i 'khyud mos bsdoms shing rna ltag gnyis su utpal rgyas pa las dar dpyangs 'phyang ba/ snyan rgyan ni rin po che'i rna kor zlum po la phra tshom gyis mdzes pa/ mgul rgyan ni g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du rin po che'i gzhung gsum gyi bar drwa bas sbrel ba mgul par 'khyil ba'i tshul du yod pa/ phyag gdub ni rin po che'i gzhung gsum gyi bar drwa bas sbrel ba che ba gnyis kyis dpung pa dang*/

chung ba gnyis kyis mkhrig mar brgyan pa/ zhabs gdub de dang 'dra ba la smad du rin po che'i zar tshags mang po 'phyang bas long bur brgyan pa'o// 'og pags sam rked rgyun ni rin po che'i gzhung lnga gyen du byas pa'i bar drwa bas sbrel zhing thur du rin po che'i chun 'phyang mang pos spras pa/ do shal ni rin po che'i phreng bas mgul nas lte ba'i 'og yan 'khor ba/ se mo do ni de las thung ba nu ma yan 'khor ba ste brgyad yin la/ drug tu bshad pa ni gdu bu rnams gcig tu brtsis/ do shal dang se mo do gcig tu brtsis pa'o// dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten cing*/ 'od kor dang 'od zer gyi phreng ba mu med pa 'phro bzhin pa dang gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum rigs bdag dang bcas pa la rim bzhin sems bzung*/ de yang gong bzhin sgrim lhod res 'jog gi tshul du bslab cing mthar lhar zhen pa'i a 'thas des sangs rgyas thob pa'i gegs kyang byed srid pas 'dzin stangs hreng hreng po de yang bshig nas dmigs med kyi lta bas rgyas btab cing skyong ba ni gtso che ste/ rgya gzhung rnams su yang lha yi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du bltas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// ༈ /gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa la/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ rigs bdag 'pho ba/ srung 'khor bsgom pa/ tshe bcud bsdu ba/ sngags bzla ba'i dmigs pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid rje btsun ma'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal ba'i thugs kar te nu ma gnyis kyi bar gyi thad sgal tshigs la nye ba'i gnas der rgyu zla ba las grub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ dbyibs leb chags la lte ba dang rtsibs dang mu khyud rnams khrol tshags kyi rnam pa can gyi lte ba'i dbus su tām̐ yig dkar po/

de'i mtha' skor du ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes g.yas skor dang*/ tām̐ yig gi mdun ngos spel tshig gi phyi rol tu oṃ/ rgyab tu hā rtsibs brgyad so so'i dbus su rim bzhin tā re tuttā re tu re swā zhes pa'i yig 'bru re yod pa rnams kha dog dkar po dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud nang ma la a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ e ai o au aṃ aḥ rnams kha dog dkar po g.yon skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la ka kha ga gha nga nas ha kṣa'i bar kha dog dkar la dmar mdangs can g.yas skor dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la ye dharmā'i sngags phreng kha dog dkar po g.yas skor du yod pa ste sngags phreng thams cad kyang langs thabs kyi rnam pa can/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba phyed mu khyud la nub cing phyed yar 'greng bur thon pa/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhig tu gnas par gyur par bsam/ gsum pa ni/ rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po sbubs can zhwa thebs kha sbyar ba lta bu/ rtse rim gyis rno ba/ g.yas skor du 'khor ba las me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi so mal du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul du tshig par bsam/ de nas snying ga'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/

nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'khor lo'i gur khang gi phyi rol du 'dom gang tsam du 'od dkar po'i gur khang du gyur/ zhi ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer ser po gser zhun ma lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dkar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ser po'i gur khang du gyur/ rgyas pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po bye ru'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ser po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dmar po'i gur khang du gyur/ dbang gi phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dmar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mthing ga'i gur khang du gyur/ drag po'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ljang gu margad zhu ba'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig car du 'grub par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od mthing ga'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ljang gu'i gur khang du gyur/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang sngags phreng las 'od zer mchin kha 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ljang gu'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mchin kha'i gur khang du gyur/

byin rlabs dang phrin las thams cad brtan par bsam/ 'od kyi gur khang drug po thams cad kyang dbyibs sgo nga'i rnam pa lta bu dum bu gcig tu gyur pa sra zhing mkhregs pa bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa/ bar mtshams thams cad utpal sngon po'i me tog kha bye ma thag pa gsar zhing mnyen lcug dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par bsam mo// de nas tām̐ yig gi klad kor gyi nang du rang gi bla ma zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku bgres gzhon bsnyun tshul bstan pa sogs ji ltar yin kyang skabs 'dir sku'i rnam pa de ka yin pa la gzhon tshul lang tsho rgyas shing na bza' sogs kyang gzab 'phyor gyi rnam pa can du bsgom pa rten 'brel gyi dgos pa dang*/ bsgrub bya gtso che ba de tām̐ yig gi khog pa'i nang dang*/ gzhan rnams g.yas g.yon gang bder so so'i rnam pa gzhon tshul gzab 'phyor can du bsgom/ 'og gi tshe bcud bstim pa'i dmigs pa sogs tshar nas ngo bo de dang de yin pa la rnam pa rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga gyen 'greng gi lte bar hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa re gsal 'debs/ de yang rdo rjes ni sku/ hūm̐ de spyir yi ge yin pas gsung*/ bye brag tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi sa bon yin pas bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor rgyas btab par 'gro bas shin tu zab ces gsung sgros zin bris kha cig las 'byung ngo*// de dag brtan pa'i phyir thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang*/ spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas 'od mchin kha'i bar rim bzhin gsal gdab/ yang phyi rol nas tshur rim bzhin gsal 'debs pa sems 'dzin dang cha 'dra ba'i sgo nas gsal snang khyad par can ma thon gyi bar du 'bad par bya'o// bzhi pa ni spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag med la mos gus dung dung ba zhig byas pas de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs thams cad du bun gyis 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten ri gling nyi zla sogs 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud dwangs ma bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu thams cad dang*/

bcud kyi sems can mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dang*/ grub pa rig 'dzin/ tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs thams cad dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za mkha' lding la sogs pa'i mi ma yin mthu bo che rnams dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po/ khams kyi rgyal phran sogs mi yi bdag po rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor dang gzi brjid dbang thang thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bsdus te phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can dang yon tan dpag tu med pa la sogs pa na bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ ri bo po ta la dang seng ldeng shing gi nags khrod sogs na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rnams dang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas mar zhom gyis lud pa gzhan du bo zeg med par rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis khengs/ bdag dang bsgrub bya rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal 'byor gzi brjid lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par byas nas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho/ rtag brtan gzhom gzhig bral ba 'gyur med rdo rje'i lus su gyur par bsam zhing*/ lus gnad bsrang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gang bde'i gung mo brkyang ba'i rgyab tu 'dzum mo bkug ste sbyar/

srin lag dang mthe'u chung lag mthil du bkug la mthe bos mnan pa rdo rje phyed pa'i phyag rgyas sna bug g.yas bkag ste g.yon nas rlung ro mgo mjug phra la dbus sbom pa nas 'dra zhig sangs kyis 'bud/ yang g.yon pa bkag la g.yas nas de bzhin 'bud/ yang gnyis ka nas mnyam du 'bud/ de nas 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bab tshul du phyed 'then tsam bya/ steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul du rdzogs par rngub cing rlung gi rta mchil ma zhig mid pa dang mnyam du lte 'og tu mnan/ slar yang 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then te kha sbyor gyi tshul du bzung*/ mi thub na dal bus btang*/ yang gong gi dmigs pa rnams gsal ba'i ngang nas bzung*/ de lta bu'i bum can gsum nas nyer gcig gi bar dmigs pa dang sbrags shing ci nus su bzung ngo*// ༈ /lnga pa ni thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang*/ 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi rkang mthil nas spyi gtsug gi bar mer gyis gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang khyad par du dus ma yin pa 'chi ba'i rgyu tshe rabs gzhan du srog bcad pa dang*/ tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu gzhan gyi 'tsho ba'i rkyen 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i las ngan thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa mukti ka'i rdog pa'am skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu khra chems chem pas bkag par bsams la rgyas pa'i las mthun gyi phreng ba'am ma 'byor na las thams cad la bho de tse kho nas rung ba rgyud kyi dgongs pa klan ka dang bral ba yin pas de lta bu'i phreng ba grangs brgya rtsa brgyad yod nges cig snyems par bzung ste/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra wardha nā ya swā hā/ zhes lan ji ltar rigs pas bsngags la g.yon pa'i mthe bong lcags kyus dngos grub 'gugs par bsam zhing gung mo'i steng nas bgrang*/
