myur ches pa la sogs pa'i skyon brgyad spangs te sems gzhan tu ma yengs pas sngags kyi grangs brgya rtsa brgyad nas stong gi bar ci nus su bzla'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni yi ge bcu pa spel tshig can kho na'o// gang dag bsgrub bya'i rim gro lta bu'i bsnyen pa'i tshe ma ma zhes pa'i tshab tu gu ru dang dā na pa ti sogs dang ming dngos rgya skad du byas nas 'jug dgos tshul smra ba ni bab col tsam ste/ dkyus kyi ma ma zhes pa ni ming la rnam dbye byin nas tshig tu grub pa ste/ bdag gi zhes pa 'gyur bas mtshon na bla ma'i zhes pa dang sbyin bdag gi zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye dang bcas pa 'don dgos par 'gyur bas brda sprod la ma sbyangs pa dag gis bsnyen pa byed mi rung bar thal ba'i skyon 'bab bo// mang du smras pas ci zhig bya ste gong gi bsgrub bya sba ba'i dmigs pa ma chad par byas la rang sems dang bsgrub bya'i sems gnyis ka'i ngo bo blo 'das brjod bral du ro gcig par shes par byas la 'dzin med du yang yang 'jog pa nyid kyis don grub par brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngan rtog gi dug chus ma bslad pa yin pas yid ches par bya'o// ༈ /spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas pas mchod bstod byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dbyangs gsal/ rten 'brel snying po/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya rnams lan gsum re bzlas pas sgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam mo// de nas thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas/ 'od mchin kha'i gur khang la thim/ de ljang gu'i/ de mthing ga'i/ de dmar po'i/ de ser po'i/ de dkar po'i/ de 'khor lo'i gur khang la/ de rang nyid/ rang yang stod smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa la/

de tām̐ yig la/ de'i khog pa mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ de yang mi dmigs par bsam la 'dzin med du 'jog go /slar yang stong nyid de'i ngang nas chu las nya ldang ba bzhin lha'i skur langs la/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba dang shis brjod byas la/ thun mtshams thams cad du snang grags rigs gsum rje btsun ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngo bor shes par bya zhing dkon mchog mchod pa/ bla ma dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ sātstsha gdab pa/ gtor ma gtong ba/ phyag dang skor ba/ mdo bklag pa/ gsod par nges pa'i sems can gyi srog slu ba/ zas skom yo byad sogs 'tsho ba'i rkyen ster ba ste mdor na chos mthun gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de rnams kyis rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa yongs su rdzogs pa rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa'i ngag gis bstan zin to// slar smras pa/ 'di ko 'gro la

de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ 'doms rnams mkhas dang grub// rim par byon gyi skyab seng rgyal brgyud min// 'khrul med gdams pa yid can ring 'tsho'i gsos// yin gyi mi tshe 'da' ba'i sgrung rgyud min// rgyu des utpa la ngag don dpe las bzhin sgra du ma can/ bzhin dad sgrol mkhyen pa'i rol sgeg las// sbrang rtsi'i bcud bzhin bsten 'os snyan brgyud thun mong yin pa'i mchog /ra yig gnyis pa ji bzhin bdag blo'i mos pas yongs blangs pa// brjed pas 'jigs phyir gsung rgyun ji bzhin nyams med brtson pas spel// 'on ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ te bdag blo'i bung ba lhan skyes 'thib bu'i bum nang du// ring nas phyogs bslad 'khor ba'i bag chags stug po'i mthu brtas pas// spyi brtol ldab ldib dbyangs su blangs la 'gal dang ma 'brel dang*// zlos pa'i skyon sogs gang mchis mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'gyod pas bshags// 'dir 'bad dge mtha' dag gzugs can/ bas tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs las nyer 'thon pa'i// rgyal ba'i go 'phang sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rnyed dka'i bsam 'phel dbang*// mtshan dpe'i 'od rnon phyogs brgyar 'bar ba'i gzi byin bzod dka' ldan// 'gro ba'i dad gsum thor tshugs rtse mor sgeg pa nyid gyur cig /ces rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge bde ldan mgon po'i zhal lung ring 'tsho'i bsil sbyin zhes pa 'di'ang nges par thams cad mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po rje btsun bla ma mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi bka' lung gser gyi cod paṇa spyi bo'i rgyan du lhung ba la brten nas/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis zhabs kyi padmo la yan lag mchog gis btud pa rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'khyams po ngag dbang legs grub kyis yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e wam̐ chos ldan du khro mo'i lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i nyin sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun gzung 'dzin 'chi bdag gi g.yul las bi dza yantu/

sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /sgrol dkar tshe khrid 'chad thabs skal bzang rna ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mchog dang bde ldan mgon// tha dad med la gus btud nas// shin tu zab pa'i tshe khrid kyi// 'chad thabs dam pa'i gsung bzhin bri// de'ang ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma bdun las mi mang ba tshe khrid zab mo'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin snga dror/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i yig cha la zhal shes gsung sgros kyis brgyan pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa gnang*/ dgongs ka'i dus su slob dpon gdan la 'khod nas bdud tshar bcad pa'i sngags tshar nyer gcig tsam bgrang*/ de nas slob ma rnams kyang gral rim bzhin 'khod nas/ slob dpon nam gzhan zhig gis bskul te/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs shlo ka gcig thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// zhes sogs brgyud 'debs dang*/ mchod g.yog gis maṇḍal gral mgo nas bkye/ gral gsham nas bsdus la/ phyag gsum btsal/ 'greng bzhin pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du dam pa'i chos kyi bka' khrid zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma bskul/ spro na gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyang bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro bas skad gdangs mthon pos/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/

de'i ched du khrid kyi rim pa zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang*/ skye rabs kyi rgyud las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni nye bar bzhag /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig tu// rab tu dwang la dri med yid// nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan ltar// rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs dang*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// ces gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi tshig don la yid mi gtod pa snod kha sbubs lta bu'i skyon dang*/ yid gtad kyang dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis mi 'dzin pa snod zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bzung yang*/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*// don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*// phyi rol rnam g.yeng yid bsdus dang*// skyo bas nyan pa dri ma yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar dri ma drug po gang rung dang ldan pa ni snod dri ma can gyi skyon te snod kyi skyon gsum spangs dgos shing*/ khyad par du tha mal snang zhen dang bcas pas gsang sngags zab mo'i chos nyan du mi rung bas/ sa phyogs 'di nyid kyang dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can lta bur gyur pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du da lta chos ston mkhan gyi slob dpon kyang tha mal pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu ma yin pa lhag pa'i lha rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing*/ gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs grags stong gnyis su med pa lhang lhang sgrogs bzhin pa/ thugs rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid kyi rgya mtsho chen po snying rje'i rba rlabs long long du g.yo ba dngos yin snyam pa dang*/

khyed rnams kyang thun mtshams kyi lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas yengs pa med pa'i tshul gyis gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ bdag cag 'gro ba yongs kyi sogs nas don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin zhes gsungs/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong byas nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// zhes sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab la spyod lam thams cad du chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i slad du da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi zhes sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ mthar/ de ring gi thugs dam de tsam la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ theg mchog dam chos sogs smon lam mnyam du mdzad nas grol// ༈ /nyin gnyis pa la/ slob dpon gyi tshe khrid rgyun gyi nyams bzhes grub 'phral slob ma rnams bos te gral la 'khod nas brgyud 'debs maṇḍal sogs 'dra/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin zhes gsungs/ zhes pa'i bar khar sang bzhin bskyar/ des khar sang gi dmigs pa song*/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la zhes pa nas/ yun ring du bltas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar/

de las ldang bar 'dod na sgrub thabs kyi 'phro rnams dkyus bzhin nyams su blangs la dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngos la chos mthun gyi spyod pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbyugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams song nas/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes pa nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ slar yang sogs nas de bzhin du bskyar mthar/ de ring gi thugs dam sogs 'dra// ༈ /nyin gsum pa la gong 'og gzhan thams cad 'dra ba la/ 'o nam mkha' dang sogs nas/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams song zin/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes pa nas/ yun ring du bltas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ des khar sang gi dmigs pa song*/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba ni/ gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa la thugs ka'i 'khor lo sogs nas/ khyad par can ma thon gyi bar du 'bad par bya'o// thun las ldang bar 'dod na sgrub thabs kyi 'phros rnams dkyus bzhin nyams su blangs la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngos la chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/

de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las thun mong du lha bsgom ba'i dmigs pa yan chad song zin nas/ gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges par sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pa'i bar bskyar mthar/ de ring gi sogs 'dra// ༈ /nyin bzhi pa la/ 'o nam mkha' dang sogs nas khar sang gi dmigs pa gong bzhin bskyar/ mthar/ des khar sang gi dmigs pa song*/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ bzhi pa tshe bcud bsdu ba ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag med/ sogs nas/ kho nas dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes mjug rdzogs pa'i bar bshad/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las srung 'khor bsgom pa yan chad song zin/ bzhi pa tshe bcud bsdu ba ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma zhes pa nas/ 'da' bar bya'o// bar rdzogs par bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges par sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ mthar de ring gi sogs 'dra// ༈ /nyin lnga pa la snga dro'i dus su chos thun 'dzugs dgos/ khar sang gi dmigs pa bskyar/ mthar/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams pa zab mo yongs su rdzogs pa kho bo cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa khyab bdag bde ldan mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa che ge mo'i zhal sgo nas ji ltar byon pa bzhin phul grub pa yin pas 'di la brten nas rang nyid kyi chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs su thog mar bsnyen pa las su rung bar byas nas rgyun gyi nyams bzhes la brtson pa'i ngang nas rang gzhan gyi don du las kyi tshogs rab 'byams sgrub pa dang skal ldan rnams gdams pas rjes su 'dzin pa la sogs pa bstan 'gro'i skabs su gang babs mdzad 'tshal/

tshe khrid zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul/ de ltar rang re rnams kyi dam pa'i chos nyan bshad byas pa la bsod nams dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa rnams bar ma dor chud mi za ba'i phyir 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas dbu zhwa phud/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun sogs spyi bsngo rgyas pa shis brjod kyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de nas gnas skabs gang 'os zhig tu slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs rgya bod kyi gzhung lung rgyun gang bzhugs kyi bklag lung bya'o// slar smras pa/ 'dir 'bad legs byas zla shel 'od// lus can snying gi ku mu dar// lhung ba tsam gyis sngon med pa'i// grub gnyis 'dab brgya grol gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang rang nyid kyis sngar brtsams pa'i gzhung gi nyer mkho rgyal khams pa wā gind+ra su siddhis sbyar ba shu bha mastu// ༈ /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pa la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge srid zhi'i dge legs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// gu ru shtsa tsintā tsakra bhe dā ya na mā mi/ tā rā 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ma// shrī ghrā phyi nang 'jigs brgyad las sgrol ma// bi rā bdag tu na ba las sgrol ma// tsintā tsakra phongs pa las sgrol ma// gang gi byin rlabs 'od rdul dkar// bdag blo'i ku mu dar phab nas// srid zhi'i tsha gdung gzhil ba dang*// zag med bde dga' stsol zhig kye// gsang sngags mtshan nyid theg pa las// khyad chos bzhi yis 'phags gyur pa'i// gnyis pa thabs tshul rnam mang po'i// bye brag 'ga' zhig 'dir brjod bya// de'ang rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo lhag pa'i lhar bzung ste/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bas mtshon pa'i rang gzhan gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa spel bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/

bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan pa las sgom bzlas kyi lung dang*/ rjes su gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' drin nos nas/ bsnyen sgrub las su rung ba sngon du 'gro bas las kyi tshogs rab 'byams la 'jug par bya'o// des na de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa la nye bar mkho ba'i reg zig cung zhig spros nas yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu bum chog la sgrub pa'i tha snyad byas pa snang mod/ phal che bas bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma tsam las/ tha dad du bya bar ma bshad pa ltar na/ thog mar dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ bza' btung bud shing sogs mthun rkyen rnams bsags la mtshams g.yog kyang yid brtan thub pa zhig la blos bkal/ gza' skar gyi khams chu nang 'phrad sogs dge ba'i nyin gnas khang byi dor byas la/ rje btsun ma'i sku bris 'bur sogs kyi rten yod na ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ de'i drung gtor sgrom mam bang khang lta bur dkar gtor gcig dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/ logs shig tu gtor ma cha gsum dang*/ mdun du rdor dril yungs kar gu gul sogs sta gon bya/ gdan gyi 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje bri ba spyi ltar byung na legs mod mi dgos ka med min/ sgo drung du tho brtsigs la dkar rtsis bran/ phyi mtshams bcad nas rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod kyis gdan la 'khod de cha gsum yo ga ltar btang*/ bgegs gtor phyir dor ba'i rjes su gu gul bdug cing yungs kar 'thor/ sa phyogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla re phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'bar bas gang bar gyur ces

mtshams bcad dus tsam las gzhan du bsam mi dgos so/ brjod/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ mchod pa rnams rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ byin rlabs spyi ltar dang dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ skyabs 'gro gang mang gzhir byas pa'i thun bsdam/ sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don ngag dbang kun blo'i yig cha'i steng nas byas na bde/ thun mthar gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ bsang sbyang gong bzhin dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul dang bcas/ a kā ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ sku rten la dmigs te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rten med na mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sogs kyis bskyed/ gang ltar yang lha'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba gtor ma la zug ste drangs par bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa tī ma hā satwa/ sarba buddha a wa lo ki te/ mā bi lamba/ mā bi lamba/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ zhes se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs sam/ lha dang lha min sogs gang rung gis bstod/ thal mo sbyar te/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

ces sogs yid la gang 'dod pa gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ rten med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang*/ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ skabs 'dir sgrol ma'i bka' sdod kṣe tra pā la dang 'jigs byed chen po la gtor ma phul na legs pa gnyan lo'i lo rgyus kyis shes mod spro na logs su 'byung ngo*// yang gtor ma cha gsum btang ba'i srol yod pa 'dre na'ang phal cher gyis mi mdzad par snang*/ de dag la mos na sbyor ba'i skabs su yi dam gyi gtor ma'i g.yas g.yon du bsham zhing bgegs gtor ni nyin re bzhin phyir dor ro// gang ltar yang rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs dang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod bcas bya/ de nas kha ton gang dgos byas la srod thun la 'jug nyi ma rjes ma rnams la gtor ma snga thun gyi rjes la 'bul/ byad rbod kyi ltas dang*/ bgegs kyi cho 'phrul che na thun mtshams rnams su rang 'khor lo'i gur khang me 'od dang bcas pa dkyus bzhin gsal bar bsgoms la yi ge bcu pa ji ltar 'di'i skabs rang gi mdun rgyab oṃ dang hā/ rtsibs rnams la tā re sogs yig 'bru brgyad 'god pa dang*/ bzlas ba'i sngags kyi swā hā'i gong du bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa zhes sogs spel tshig gzhug par gsungs shing*/ dkyus la 'di tsam gyis kyang don 'grub par bshad pas gang mos bya/ rigs pa bzla/ kha ton gzhan yod na thun mtshams gang 'os su byas pas chog cing bslab bya phra mo rnams ni spyi'i bsnyen thabs las rtogs par bya'o// mdor na thun gsum mam bzhi'i sbyor bas dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug tu sgom bzlas la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba ni rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan yin pas gtso bor bya/ grangs bsnyen la mos na 'bum phrag bcu bzla dgos te/

lha sngags kyi dngos gzhi yi ge bcur gnas pa 'bru 'bum gyi rtsis dang*/ de nyid brgyad 'gyur du byas pas 'bum phrag brgyad cu bzlas na legs pa sgrol ma'i man ngag gnyan sgrol dang ku ru kulle sogs/ gur dang saṃ ṭa'i rdo rje slob ma'i skabs sogs nas bshad cing*/ thun mong sgrub pa'i lha gzhan nas kyang 'byung*/ de ltar grub na dus bsnyen dang gzhi mthun par 'gyur bas shin tu legs par mngon/ gzhan dang*/ rgyud 'grel rnams nas kyang 'byung ngo*// deng sang spel tshig can la bzhi 'bum mdzad pa ni yig 'bru bco lnga las lhag pa la de ltar bzla dgos pa spyir btang gi dbang du song ba'o// yang na rgya gzhung du/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni// skyo ba med pa'i sems kyis bzla// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi yi ge gzhan dang yang sgo bstun na/ bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi yi ge bcu pa kho na la grangs bzung zhing*/ thun mjug tu spel tshig can cung zad re bzla/ snga ma 'bru 'bum sogs them pa dang*/ spel tshig can la zhag bdun sogs sgrub bsnyen gyi tshul du byas pas don 'grub bo// gang ltar yang bsnyen tshad legs par rdzogs nas kha skong gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i yig cha de las kyang bsnyen pa gang la song ba'i sngags kyis til 'bul bar bshad pas/ spel tshig can kho na mi dgos par grub bo// yi ge'i steng nas bya zhing*/ der thab thig spyi ltar bya gsungs pa ni/ sa ma dul ba'i gnas lta bu yin na/ bslang ba dang sbyang gzung mdor bsdus pa byas bdag bskyed mdor bsdus sngon du 'gro ba'i sa lha lhag gnas dkyil chog gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ mkhyen gsol gyi tshig cung zad bsgyur/ slar gzhi bdag la gtor ma sbyin/ sa lag pa gnyis kyis bcag la/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs la/ gnas 'dir sbyin sreg byas la rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub snyam pa'i blos yongs su bzung ngo*/

nas/ thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ dbus nas khru phyed kyis zlum po bskor ba thab khung dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa/ lan gnyis bskor ba kha khyer dang mu ran/ tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la thig bzhi'i rtse legs par sbrel ba'i stegs bu gru bzhi dang*/ de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyis cha ga stegs bu'i dpangs kyis tshad mtshon/ mdzad/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba padma'i lte ba dang*/ phyi'i sum gnyis la padma'i 'dab ma bri/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar po dang bcad tshon sogs dmar skyas bya/ mu ran la rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng bas bskor zhing dbus kyi mtshan ma sogs dkyus bzhin/ rdzas rnams kyang mang nyung tshan gnyis bshams pa'i phud las mang bar byas pa 'das pa'i me lha dang*/ me lha lhag mas mchod pa'i ched du/ lhag ma las nyung bar byas pa thog mar me lha mchod pa'i ched du'o// rdzas byin rlabs skabs rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa'i gung mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sprad pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i khongs su zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa bkrus par bsam zhing sngags rnams brjod/ 'dug stangs tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa'i spyod lam mam skyil krung byas pa'i pus mo'i khongs las gru mo phyir mi 'da' bas/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang mthun par dgang blugs 'dzin pa byon skyems sogs kun la gru mo phyir mi 'da' ba'i kun spyod 'di/ sbyin sreg ma tshar bar grub na legs mod/ dgang blugs 'dzin dus cis kyang 'bad/

mi 'da'i don lag pa spyi la bzhed pa'ang yod 'dra/ 'gre/ zhi ba spyi ltar 'das pa'i rigs bdag rnam snang byas kyang 'gal ba med/ mchod 'bul gyi tshigs bcad maṇḍal bzhi chog nas 'byung zhing*/ mi shes na rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshe chog ltar ram 'og tshogs bsag gi skabs nas 'byung ba cung zad bsgyur/ til bsnyen pa'i bcu cha 'bul dgos pas nyin grangs ji tsam 'gor ba'i bar du bya'o// sbyin sreg yun ring mi 'dzom pa shar na kha skong phal cher bsnyen pa'i dkyus su 'gro bar byed/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub sngon du btang nas las sna tshogs kyi sgo nas rang gzhan la phan gdags par bya ste/ yi ge rnying pa rnams dang mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa las kyang rtogs par bya'o// ༈ /de nyid du'am gnas skabs gzhan du rang gzhan gyi tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas pa'i don du sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ bsham dang cho ga phal cher zhi ba gzhir bzhag la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas khru gang gi tshad kyi srad bus phyogs bzhi'i tshangs thig la mtshan ma byas la de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas mtshan ma'i steng nas bzung*/ g.yas pas zur thig la ri mo rgya gram bya/ de dag gi steng du thig bzhi btab pas thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi rol du shar sogs phyogs bzhir sor brgyad pa gnyis kyi mtshan ma la/ rtags nang ma nas dbus bar gyi srad bu des zur thig bzhi la mtshan ma byas te thig btab pas kha khyer 'byung*/ yang rtags phyi ma nas dbus bar gyi srad bu des sngar ltar zur thig bzhi la mtshan ma byas te thig btab pas mu ran 'byung la thab stegs ni mi bshad ba bzhin ma shongs na phyed phyed cha phri bas rung tsam yin par gsungs shing*/ zhi ba sog la'ang 'gre'o// dgos so// thab nang sum gnyis pad 'dab bya ba sogs zhi ba dang 'dra/ gzhi thams cad ser po dang bcad tshon li khris bya/

mu ran la rin po che'i phreng ba bri/ kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing gru bzhir brtsigs pa'i nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor ting lo bzhag rdzas la yam shing dug dang tsher ma can ma yin pa/ shug pa sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing gang rung sbom phra gung mo tsam ser zhing dri lo 'bras ma nyams pa byung na mchog tu legs shing gsher yod pa ni nges par dgos/ zhim pa/ khru gang ba rtsa rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa dang*/ tshe rgyas pa gtsor bya dgos pas dūrba'i myu gu zho dang 'o ma sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ rtsa rtse ma nor ba brgya rtsa brgyad re khres por byas pa gang mang dang*/ zhar byung bsod nams rgyas pa'i don du 'bras ma chag pa gur gum yung ba sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba bcas grangs 'dzin pa'i ched du bsham/ rdzas gzhan dang mchod gtor zhi ba dang ser por kha bsgyur zhing snod dang stegs sogs ser por byed pa'i srol yang yod/ 'dra/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhal lhor bstan pa'i mdun du rnal 'byor pa'i stan ser po'i steng du sa 'ja' li lta bu bzhag snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus bya/ gos rgyan ser pos brgyan la rang gzhan gyi tshe dang bsod nams sogs rab tu rgyas par bya'o snyam pa tshims pa'i sems kyis kha byang du bltas te bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes pa khyel 'dug bya/ dngos gzhi la/ bsang chu dang mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed nyer bsdu las lhar bzhengs pa'i bar 'dra/ dpal 'bar dge 'dun gyi rung khang ngam rgyal po'i khyim gyi mes sbar la thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas skor bya/ lag gnyis khu tshur las mtheb mdzub gnyis brkyangs te rtse sbyar ba'i rin chen khu tshur gyis dgang blugs bzung*/ thab bskyed pa'i skabs su hūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gnyis pa zabs su khru gang pa/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/

dbyibs gru bzhi pa mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ me lha bskyed pa'i skabs su sku mdog dmar po 'od zer ser po 'phro zhing 'du ba sogs dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes bsgyur/ ku sha byin rlabs skabs su/ bdag cag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par byed pa la zhes dang*/ de nyid dgram pa'i skabs su rgyas par gyur cig ces bsgyur/ byon zan 'bul ba'i skabs su/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang sogs sam/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe sogs dang*/ bdag cag 'dus pa rnams kyi tshe dang sogs skabs thob rtsis pa'i kha bsgyur gong 'og thams cad la 'gre'o// yam shing la oṃ agna ye swāhā/ oṃ bodhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags gsum sbrel ba lan gcig dang*/ de nas rdzas sngags rkyang pa bcu dgu/ slar yang gsum sbrel gcig ste lan nyer gcig phul/ 'og ma rnams la'ang de'i 'gros kyis/ mar la oṃ agna ye swā hā/ oṃ agna ye= 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ til lam yungs kar la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra yungs kar gyis byed na pā paṃ gyi gnas su bighnā zhes bcug kyang rung*/ ya swā hā/ dge ba phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zas mchog la/ oṃ agna= oṃ sarba saṃ ba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'bras la oṃ agna= oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ so ba la/ oṃ agna= oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ nas la/ oṃ agna= oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

sran ma la/ oṃ agna= oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ gro la/ oṃ agna= oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dūrba la/ oṃ agna= oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ ku sha la/ oṃ agna= oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pa rdzas sngags 'di rnams tshig tu grub pa'i rjes la ma nges pa sna tshogs su snang ba ni yig skyon yin par nges shing yig cha dag pa rnams su rnam dbye bzhi pa'i dang po kho na phyi na 'dug pa ni sgra'i gzhung dang mthun pas shin tu legs la 'di tsam du ma zad gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o// rnams so// 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i skabs kyi/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i rjes su/ lha de nyid 'dzum zhing tshim pa'i nyams can/ gzi brjid 'bar ba/ 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad par gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ byon skyems dang rdzas kyi sngon 'gro'i lha sngags yi ge bcu pas bya zhing*/ spel tshig gong dang 'dra/ yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams grangs brgya rtsa brgyad re nges par 'bul/ de nas sngags spel tshig can re dang dūrba nyag ma re 'bras ser cung zad bcas sbrags nas dbul/ brgya rtsa brgyad re song ba'i gsham du byon skyems kyi skabs ltar spel tshig brjod/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis dūrba stong ngam khri la sogs pa gang

'chi bslu'i gzhung las shar dang byang du rtse bstan zhes pas zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gnyis bstan pa sngon gyi mchan las 'byung ngo*/na 'gro bya/ bar skabs rnams su yam shing dang mar cung zad 'bul/ 'bras ser gyi tshab zas mchog la byas kyang rung ngo*// 'dod don gsol gdab kyi mjug tu/ khyad par du tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ me lha lhag mas mchod pa'i skabs su spel tshig sogs gong dang 'dra/ 'dod don gsol gdab ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi tshe dang sogs sngar bzhin brjod pa ma gtogs 'dra'o// ༈ /yang bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis bum pa la brten pa'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor sbrags ma'i tshul gyis rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par 'dod na/ gnas dben par mtshams bcad/ rin po che'i bum pa gas chag med par bcud nyer lnga gzhug rgyun 'bab kyi chu gtsang ma tsandan dkar dmar gur gum sogs sbyar bas sum gnyis tsam dgang*/ mgul chings kha rgyan sogs spyi ltar bcas la mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dngos gzhi la/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang bdag bskyed byas la/ bum pa yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyis gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ārya tā re zhes re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/

shabda'i bar/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis mchod cing bstod/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin sogs nas 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med sogs nas bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha yi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs/ de dang dus mnyam du spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te/ phyag gi bum nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur pa de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pa bum pa'i chu dang 'dres shing yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la gzungs thag 'dzin pas sngags spel tshig can gang 'gro bzla/ thun mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ ā li kā li ye dhar yig brgya rnams tshar gsum re brjod pas byin rlabs brtan par bya/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas gtor sngags lan gsum gyis bum pa'i lha la 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab bcas dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu bas bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/ gtor ma cha gsum gtong bar mos na skabs 'dir bya/ gang ltar rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis bsrung ba bsngo smon shis brjod bcas bya/ de lta bu'i thun gsum mam bzhi'i sbyor bas zhag bdun la sogs pa bsgrubs nas/ slar yang bum chu rul ba g.ya' sogs kyi skyon spang ba'i phyir phye gtsang mas sbrus la ril bur byas te/

gsher thag chod pa dang bum par blugs/ yang na dam pa snga ma 'gas bcud len sman sbyor gang rigs bya ba bshad pa ltar mos na/ rgyud dang gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos rnams nas 'byung mod/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sha sbyor gyi rigs rnams ni sbyang rtogs sbar gsum dngos su nus pa'i brtul zhugs grub pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin la/ dngul chu dang khaṇḍa'i sbyor ba rnams ni dka' tshegs che bas/ bcud len spyi 'gre tsam du bum chu mang nyung la dpags te/ gtso bor a ru ra sha mthug gser mdog de'i phyed tsam gyi skyu rus pa phral pa/ ru ra/ de'i phyed tsam ba ru ra/ de dang mnyam pa'i rtsa ba lnga/ dbang lag dūrba rnams dang*/ kha tshar gyi tshul du bzang po drug cha mnyam pa cung zad tsam dang*/ ka ra bcas sbyar la ril bur bya/ yang na gso rig man ngag rgyud las bshad pa'i bcud len gyi rdzas ni/ pho nas tsam brdung ba tshul bcos te yang yang bshal/ slar mjo ba ro 'dam 'thag byas na so sogs mi 'byung bas legs gsungs/ cong*/ brag zhun/ bur dkar/ sbrang btul ma/ mar gsar bcas dngas ma lnga dang*/ shug 'bras/ ba lu/ mtshe/ 'khan dkar bcas rtsi bzhi ste de dag cha mnyam pa gtso shug 'bras sogs kyis ro kha ba 'gyur du dogs ma btang lugs bya ba'am/ kar sogs bung che bas ro bsgyur/ bor byas la/ kha tshar gyi tshul du dbang lag sor mo lnga pa bzhi pa dang gsum pa'ang btang du rung ba tsam yin la/ de kun la yang ba cung 'gugs ba zhes thog mar chu la btsos te 'bo/ skam pa dang btags la 'o mar sbyar/ tsam 'dzom mam/ snga ma rnams cha mnyam la cung zad bsnan pa'am/ yang na/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i 'chi bslu'i gzhung 'di la 'gyur khyad kyis mi 'dra ba phran bu tsam 'dug na'ang*/ 'gyur rnying mchan dang bcas pa 'di sngon dus bshad pa dang man ngag gnyis ka yod pa'i stabs kyis legs snyam par shar bas/ de nyid las/ 'bras bu gsum ni spyir bsdus pa'am// so sor bhṛṅga rā dzar bcas// rnal 'byor pa yis rtag spyad na// phan zhing bdud rtsir 'gyur ba ste// gnyer ma skra dkar rnams dang bral// rdo rje'i lus ni gzugs bzang ldan// bskal pa yi ni grangs snyed du// 'chi ba nges par zlog pa yin// ces gsungs pa'i mchan las thang lta bu khu pa'i don du snang na'ang*/

phye ma'am ril bur byas kyang mi 'gal bas/ 'bras gsum sbyor tshad bcas sngar smros pa'i steng du bhṛṅga rā dza te ra mo shag bsnan pa tsam bhṛṅga rā dza ni ra mo shag yin par rje btsun grags pas gsungs shing*/ yongs grags ra mnye ste sa mkhregs par skyes pa legs/ 'on kyang mkhas grub tā ra nā thas bhṛṅga rā dza ra mo shag yin par snga rabs pa phal mo che 'dod kyang*/ tshab rung yin gyi dngos ni 'phral skad du bhaṅga zer ba mon phan chad du 'bol po skye ba'i dkar nag gnyis las bcud len gyi skabs su nag po nyid legs zhes gsungs/ gang ltar yang ba ru ra dang mnyam pa bya zhing kha tshar gang yang ma byung yang chog go /bcud len gyi rdzas 'di dag rten 'brel gyi che bas a ru sogs gtso bo rnams rjes la brdung bar bzhed cing*/ dar tshags nas drang zhing legs par 'thag go/ gyis 'thus so// gang ltar yang bum chus ril bu sran ma 'phos pa tsam du dril la grib skam byas te bum pa che ba zhig du blugs la mchod gtor sogs 'dra ba las dung chos mi dgos/ dngos gzhi'i ngag 'don ni/ gzhan gong bzhin la bum bskyed skabs/ nang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang gi stod kyi char pam̐ las padma sogs nas gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pa ril bu rnams la thim pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tshe dang lus kyi bcud len du gyur par bsam la sngags bzla/ sgrub grogs yod na gzungs thag 'dzin res kyis sngags rgyun mi 'chad par byas na shin tu legs/ rjes chog gi bzod gsol gyi mjug tu/ oṃ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba ril bu dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces bsgyur/ de lta bu'i rim pas mtshan ma bzang po ma byung gi bar ram zhag bdun phrag lnga'am gsum la sogs pa bsgrub bo// cho ga snga phyi gnyis ka'am/ snga ma tsam bsgrub bya re zung tsam gyi don du tshe sgrub rtsal thon du byed na/

bum lha'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal 'debs pa'i zhor la/ rang gi bla ma yin na tām̐ yig gi klad skor gyi nang dang*/ sbyin bdag sogs yin na tām̐ gyi khog pa'i nang du rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta bar bsgom/ tshe bcud bsdu ba'i ngag 'don skabs/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pa lha'i spyi bo nas brgyud de bsgrub bya'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma phyir bab pa bum pa'i chu dang 'dres shing yongs su gang bar gyur ces pa'am/ ril bu la bstim pa'i tshul gong 'di lta bu 'phags pa rin po ches rnam 'joms ba ri'i lugs dang*/ tshe dpag med sprul sku'i bum chog las gsungs shing*/ gzhan las kyang mthong ngo*// bzhin no// de ltar tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i bum chu de 'thung zhing khrus bya ba'am/ ril bu yin na za ma tog la sogs par bcangs nas gza' skar dge bar 'phrod pa'i nyin nas bzung tho rangs kyi char gtsang sbra dang bcas te bsten na nad sogs 'byongs shing*/ ji skad bshad pa'i yon tan rnams 'byung ba gdon mi za ste/ gzhung las/ sman rnams kyi ni ma thul yang*// som nyi bya bar rigs min te// gang phyir sman gyi nus pa ni// bsam mi khyab par kun tu snang*// zhes gsungs pas so// gnas skabs 'gar mdun bum sgrub mchod rgyas par bya bar 'dod na rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho ltar ram/ rje zhwa lu pa rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong gi gsung ltar nyams su 'di'i mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar bsgrub bya 'god pa dkyus bzhin nam/ 'bri gung lo rtsā ba ma ṇi ka'i sgrub skor du mdun bskyed kyi mdun du bsgrub bya gsal btab nas dngos grub stsol ba'i dmigs pa bya bar gsungs pas gang bde bya'o//

blang ngo*// ༈ /gang zhig rnam par spros pas mi skyo ba'i sgrub pa pos/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa'i phyir ram/ 'chi ba bslu ba la sogs pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i maṇḍal bya bar 'dod na/ sa stegs zlum po sogs bzos nas 'thas par brdungs la/ nags kyi rtswa sogs zos pa'i ba ser skya'i lci ba sa la ma lhung bas mtshon pa'i ba byung lnga tshad bzhin sbyar bas byugs slob dpon kaṃ pa la dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs kyi gzhung bzhin/ pa'am/ mi lcogs pa'am ma rnyed na rin po che sogs kyi maṇḍal dang*/ byug rdzas kyang tsandan gur gum sogs dri bzang po dang sbyar ba'i chus rung bas de dag dang*/ tshom bu 'god rgyu'i me tog gam 'bras sam nas dkar mo gang rung dang*/ dung chos sogs su bsang gtor gyi spos chu ku sha'i 'thor yab bcas dang*/ ril ba lta bur khrus kyi chu dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams kyang nyer bsdogs bya/ thog mar sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas bde ba mchog la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du de bzhin gshegs pa'i maṇḍal bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal bas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas pas bsang gtor dang*/ oṃ badzrod ke a mṛ taṃ bha wa hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas khrus chu byin gyis brlab/ khrus chu nas blangs te ji ltar bltams pa sogs bcas dang*/ oṃ wa swā hā/ ces pas rkang lag bzhi'am lag pa tsam dang*/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā zhes pas kha bkru'o// oṃ hūm̐ zhes pas stan byin gyis brlabs nas bsdad de/ oṃ badzra bhū mi hūm̐ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gzhi blos bzung la/ me tog dri bzang gi chus sngar bzhin du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te puṣpa ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ puṣpe puṣpe/ ma hā puṣpe/ su puṣpe/ puṣpodbha we/ puṣpa saṃ bha we/ puṣpa a wa kirṇe swā hā/

zhes lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis me tog blangs te gnas gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas lus ngag yig gsum lhag gnas bya/ yang de bzhin du me tog blangs te mgor bzhag cing*/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badzri ṇī ma hā pra ti sā re rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba satwāṃshtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// zhes pas bdag nyid bsrung*/ maṇḍal gyi gzhi la bsang gtor bya zhing*/ oṃ swa bhā wa bhū mi badzrī bha wa hūm̐/ zhes pas bsal/ slar yang g.yon skor gyis 'thor zhing*/ oṃ badzra sa twa sarba bighnān a nut+sā da ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bgegs bskrad/ byug rdzas blangs te lag g.yas skor du khye ma med par byug bzhin pas/ ba yi lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa yang dag byi dor byed pa tshul khrims dang*/ srog chags phra mo'ang bsal ba bzod pa bya ba nyer gnas brtson 'grus so// sems rtse gcig de'i skad cig bsam gtan ri mo mdzes 'bar shes rab yin// thub pa'i maṇḍal bgyis las pha rol phyin drug 'di dag thob 'gyur zhing*// kha dog gser du 'gyur zhing nad kun las ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur// lha dang mi las ches lhag 'gyur dang zla ba lta bu'i mdzes pa 'bar// 'dir ni lus kyi las bgyis ba las sangs rgyas pa yi khyim dag tu// nor dang gser gyis yang dag 'byor zhing rgyal po'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur// ces pa don dran bzhin pas brjod/ yang mtha' skor du zlum ris dri chu de nyid kyis bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra re khe hūm̐ zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas pa ma bteg pa'i rgyab tu g.yon pas me tog bzhag la/ oṃ su re khe sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣṭhantu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lag pa steng 'og bsgyur te me tog maṇḍal gyi dbus su dor ba lhag gnas byas la/ oṃ wa swā hā zhes pas lag pa bkru'o// slar yang*/ oṃ tsand+ra arka bi ma le swā hā/ zhes pas maṇḍal zla ba dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la dbus su me tog gi tshom bu 'god pa dang bstun/

ngag tu/ tām̐ slob dpon a bhā ya'i chos spyod sogs su oṃ nā ma tā re tām̐ zhes lta bur snang mod kyi/ gzhung phal mo cher sa bon sngon dang nā ma rjes su 'byung ba 'di brjod pa dang bzung bde bar snang bas bkod pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig tu nā mo zhes 'dud pa'i skad dod du 'dug pa ni yig skyon yin nam snyam/ gzhan yang maṇḍal la dri'i thig le dang tshom bu gnyis bya bar bshad pa ni/ snga ma gdam dang phyi ma lhar gsal 'debs rgyu yin zhing sa bon gyi 'jug pa yod med ci rigs pa mthong la/ de gnyis gang rung las mi 'byung ba ni lha'i gdan tsam gyi don du bshad pas skabs 'di'ang tshom bu dngos gdan dang lha gnas mi 'chol ba'i don du shes par bya zhing rgyu mtshan dpyad pas khyab bo/ tā rā nā ma/ dbus su rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan la tām̐ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo sogs nas 'od kor can/ de'i spyi bor hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// 'og ma rnams la'ang sngags brjod pa dang mnyam du tshom bu 'god cing*/ oṃ bai ro tsa na nā ma/ shar du seng ge'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ trām̐ ratna saṃ bha wa nā ma/ lhor rta mchog gi khri dang pad zla'i gdan la trām̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ hūm̐ akṣo bhya nā ma/ nub tu glang po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ oṃ a mo gha siddhi nā ma/ byang du mkha' lding gi khri dang pad zla'i gdan la kham̐ las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ka'ang mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ zla ba la rgyab brten cing 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// lam̐ lo tsa nī nā ma/ shar lhor pad zla'i gdan la lam̐ las spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo'i lte bar spyan gyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ mām̐ mā ma kī nā ma/ lho nub tu pad zla'i gdan la mam̐ las mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ pam̐ pāṇḍa ra wā si nī nā ma/ nub byang du pad zla'i gdan la pam̐ las gos dkar mo g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ gsum ka'ang phyag g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ tām̐ tā rā nā ma/ byang shar du pad zla'i gdan la tām̐ las sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon utpal

phyag mtshan 'di rnams thugs kar 'dzin pa'o// 'dzin pa/ lha mo bzhi ka'ang mdzes shing sgeg la bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor can/ ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// zhes pas gsal gdab/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams snang bar byas/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad bskul te maṇḍal gyi lha'i rnam pas byon par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes se gol sgra dang bcas pas spyan drangs pa/ sa ma ya staṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bskyed pa dang gnyis su med par blta'o// de nas maṇḍal gyi byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du zhabs 'dags rdzas dang ma 'byor na dri bzang sbyar/ bsil dang*/ zhal 'o ma'am mngar gsum/ bsil/ shar lhor 'thor chu gtsang ku sha'i 'thor yab bcas/ 'thung*/ lhor mchod la rdzas bdun bshad tshod ltar ram/ ma 'byor na dri zhim pa'i me tog dkar po tsam bcug yon/ lho nub tu me tog nub tu bdug spos dang*/ mar me/ nub byang du dri ba dri lnga ka'am/ tsandan dkar po dang gur gum tsam nges par sbyar/ chab/ byang du zhal zas rnams gru bzhir bshams pa'i phyi'am nang gang bder spos mar me zhal zas rnams lha grangs dang mnyam pa so so'i thad sor mchod pa thams cad lha grangs bzhin dgos par bshad kyang*/ phyag len la gsum po 'di tsam las mi bshams pa ni/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ mchod yon gsum ni bzed zhal du lha grangs bzhin sbreng zhing*/ 'thor 'thung dri chab me tog gsum yang de skad 'thor bas chog pa la dgongs so// des na spos mar me zhal zas rnams ni 'degs pa'i srol cher med mod/

spyi mchod kyi de 'degs tsam bya ba'am phyag rgya kyang btub bo/ bsham/ zhabs bsil sogs kyi nang thad du mañdzi'i khar bzed zhal gsum me tog nyung tsam re dang bcas pa dang*/ spro na mchod pa'i maṇḍal yang mngon par 'du bya'o// thog mar phyag bya ba ni/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs shlo ka gcig dang*/ ye shes lnga yi rol pa las// mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i sku// sprul pa'i snang chen 'gyed pa'i bdag /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud// tshad med bzhi yi ting 'dzin ni// shes rab sgyu mar 'phos pa'i gar// zag med bde ba'i rol mo pa// rigs kyi yum chen bzhi la 'dud// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du// bdag lus mngon par sprul byas nas// ngal ba 'bras dang bcas pa'i phyir// bla med sems kyis phyag bgyid do// zhes phyag byas nas mchod pa rnams la bsang gtor bya zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rgyu rang gzhan gyi dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo dag cing gtsang ba/ rnam pa yid du 'ong ba/ byed las mchod yul rnams dgyes pa skyed nus pa/ rgya dang tshad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid du gnas pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa la 'gran bzod par gyur/ ces dang so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ chu bzhi la las sngags lan bzhi dang*/ me tog sogs la oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ sogs rang sngags dang*/ thun mong du nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇaṃ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas so so'i thad du 'greng bzhin pas tshigs bcad kyi tshe rdo rje thal mo dang*/

sngags kyi dus su pad kor dang bcas mchod pa rnams bteg ste lha grangs bzhin paṇa chen nags rin gyi phyag bzhes las g.yon pas dril bu gsil zhing*/ g.yas pas bteg la dbul zhes 'byung*/ dbul/ de yang dbyangs dang bcas te/ dri med yid 'ong lha yi chu// yan lag brgyad ldan zhabs bsil mchog /rje btsun 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// tshe dang ye shes stsal du gsol// oṃ ārya tā re pra wa ra sattā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ a mi ta bha wa ra sogs/ oṃ bai ro tsa na= oṃ ratna saṃ bha wa= oṃ akṣo bhya= oṃ a mo gha siddhi= oṃ lo tsa nī= oṃ mā ma kī ni= oṃ paṇḍa ra wā si nī= oṃ tā re pra wa ra sattā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ 'og ma rnams kyang de dang 'dra ba las/ zhabs bsil gyi gnas su zhal bsil dang*/ 'thor 'thung zhes pa tsam dang*/ phyi ma'i rkang pa gnyis la rdzas bdun dang bcas arghaṃ mchog ces bsgyur zhing*/ pā dyaṃ gyi gnas su/ āñtsa ma naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ arghaṃ rnams bcug ste chu bzhi dbul/ slar yang*/ dri med yid 'ong lha yi rdzas// rab mdzes me tog rgya mtsho'i sprin// rje btsun sogs tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis 'dra/ oṃ ārya tā rā ya badzra puṣpe tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ a mi ta bha wā ya badzra puṣpe hrīḥswā hā/ oṃ bai ro tsa nā ya badzra puṣpe oṃ swā hā/ oṃ ratna saṃ bha wā ya badzra puṣpe trām̐ swā hā// oṃ akṣo bhyā ya badzra puṣpe hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha siddha ye badzra puṣpe khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ lo tsa n+yai badzra puṣpe laṃ swā hā/ oṃ mā ma kyai badzra puṣpe māṃ swā hā/ oṃ paṇḍa ra wā sa n+yai badzra puṣpe paṃ swā hā/ oṃ tā ra ya badzra puṣpe tām̐ swā hā/ 'og ma rnams la tshig rkang gnyis pa/ dri zhim bdug pa rgya mtsho'i sprin// snang gsal sgron ma= sim byed byug pa= bcud ldan zhal zas rgya mtsho'i sprin// zhes pa rnams rim bzhin brje ba dang*/

puṣpe'i gnas su dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye rnams bcug la dbul/ bsdu na chu bzhi dang tshigs bcad dor ba'i sngags tsam gyis nyer spyod lnga 'bul/ slar yang*/ tshogs pa las byung sgra snyan gyis// chos kun skye med ston pa dang*// zin dang ma zin rol mo'i tshogs// ji snyed blo yis blangs te 'bul// zhes dang rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyis chu bzhi med pa'i tshe nyer spyod rnams mdun du bkod mdzes su bsgrigs pa las bskor bsham mi dgos so// 'bul sngags 'di rnams la mi 'dra ba mang mod/ nags rin gyi nyams bzhes thor rnam dbye yod med dang*/ sa bon 'jug tshul sogs 'di bzhin yod pa/ slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyi gzhung dang mthun zhing stabs kyang bde bar snang ngo*// rol mo spyir dbul lo// gzhan yang chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing chos can rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mi bslu ba'i bden pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams kyi dri ma med pa'i smon lam gyi mthu dang*/ gzungs dang rig sngags zab mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ bdag gi lhag bsam dang mos pa'i stobs kyis/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i cod pan la sogs brgyan gyi bye brag rnams dang*/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs la sogs pa lhab lhub kyi rnam pa du ma dang bla re dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ dar gyi lda ldi dang*/ rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba'i chun 'phyang dang*/ gdugs dang rnga yab dang seng ge'i khri dar zab nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa dang*/ khyogs dang bzhon pa dang*/ rta babs dang*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba dang*/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dang*/ chos gos dang*/ mal cha dang*/ lhung bzed dang*/ snyun gyi gsos sman la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad mtha' dag dang*/ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rin po che bdun dang*/ khang bzang dang*/ skyed mos tshal la sogs pa nye ba'i rin chen bdun dang*/

bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang rtags rnam pa brgyad dang*/ sgo lnga'i longs spyod so so'i yon tan gyi khyad par rdzogs pa/ mdor na mchod pa'i sprin phung dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang ba rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi spyan lam du srid pa'i mthar thug par 'byung bar gyur cig ces dang*/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ namaḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa manta swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra pra mārda ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā biryā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing se gol gtogs/ de nas/ oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra haṃ/ badzra ratna ma nutta raṃ/ badzra dharma gā ya nai/ badzra karma ka rodbha we/ zhes pa'i glu sngon du 'gro bas/ gar skor dang bcas so so'i phyag rgya 'cha' zhing*/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā le trām̐/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nṛ tye aḥ slar yang glu dang*/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trām̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe aḥ zhes pas sgeg sogs brgyad sprul la mchod 'di dag la rim bzhin/ phyi nang*/ yid las byung ba dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa zhes pa'i tha snyad sbyar rung ngo*/ do// maṇḍal 'bul bar spro na/ ji ltar rigs pa'i maṇḍal gyi gzhi la dri bzang pos g.yas skor du byug cing*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ mtha' skor du byug cing*/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug tu gyur/ lag pa ma bteg pa'i ngang nas me tog dbus su bzhag la hūm̐ zhes pas bsrung ngo*// de nas sngags brjod pa dang mnyam du me tog gi tshom bu rnams bkod cing dngos po de dang der bsams la/

dbus su oṃ haṃ su me ra be swā hā/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar du oṃ yaṃ pūrba bi de hā ya swā hā/ lus 'phags po/ lhor oṃ raṃ dzambu dwī pā ya swā hā/ 'dzam bu gling*/ nub tu oṃ lam̐ a pa ra go dā nī ye swā hā/ ba lang spyod/ byang du oṃ waṃ utta ra ku ra be swā hā/ sgra mi snyan/ shar gling gi g.yas g.yon du sngags lan gnyis kyis/ oṃ ya u pa dwī pā ya swā hā/ lus dang lus 'phags/ lho gling gi g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ ra u pa dwī pā ya swā hā/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub gling gi g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ la u pa dwī pā ya swā hā/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ byang gling gi g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ wa u pa dwī pā ya swā hā/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ de dag gi nang du shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi dang*/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir rim pa bzhin du/ oṃ ya ga dza ratnā ya swā hā/ glang po rin po che/ oṃ ra pu ru ṣa ratnā ya swā hā/ blon po rin po che/ oṃ la a shwa ratnā ya swā hā/ rta rin po che/ oṃ wa st+rī ratnā ya swā hā/ btsun mo rin po che/ oṃ ya khaḍga ratnā ya swā hā/ dmag dpon rin po che/ oṃ ra tsakra ratna ya swā hā/ 'khor lo rin po che/ oṃ la ma ṇi ratnā ya swā hā/ nor bu rin po che/ oṃ wa ma hā ni dhi dhyaḥswā hā/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ ri rab kyi shar nub tu/ oṃ aṃ sūryā ya swā hā/ nyi ma/ oṃ a tsand+ra ya swā hā/ zla ba rnams dang gzhan yang lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ lhag bsam rnam dag chu gter las 'khrungs gling mang 'dab ma rab rgyas shing*// ri rab lhun po'i ze'u 'bru rnam mdzes nyi zla'i 'od kyi mdangs bzang can// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor dri bsung rab 'phro nam mkha'i dbyings ltar kun khyab pa'i// rin chen maṇḍal mchog 'di bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// zhes

maṇḍal tshom bu nyer gsum ma 'di bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i gzhung gis gtsos mang po zhig la 'byung la/ sngags kyi mtha' na maḥzhes snang ba go ba dang 'don pa dka' zhing*/ dze tā ri'i gzhung swā hā yod pa chos spyod rin chen phreng ba sogs su bshad pa ltar na bde bar snang ngo*// brjod/ gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma bsang sbyang byin brlab/ āñtsa ma naṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhal bsil nas/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i gtor sngags lan gsum gyi thun mong du dbul/ slar yang zhal bsil nas/ oṃ badzra tambu la swā hā/ zhes pas so rtsi bstab bo// bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas thun mong du/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par du gtso mo la/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ slar yang yul de dag gi spyan sngar pus btsugs thal mo sbyar la don dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung ngo*// sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran pa dang bcas te/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas rdzogs pa'i bar ram/ sangs rgyas rjes dran tsam bton la/ lha'i thugs kar yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig tu gtad de bying rgod kyi skyon sogs bsal nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du dar cig mnyam par bzhag de nas grub na de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa dang*/ lha sngags yi ge bcu pa ci nus su bzla'o// spro na mchod pa rnams kha gsos nas byin rlabs dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus tsam bya/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa 'chags/ dge ba 'di yis bdag nyid ni// sangs rgyas nyid du mngon gyur nas// 'gro kun gting dang mtha' med pa'i// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab/ ye shes dkyil 'khor las 'ongs pa'i// thugs rje'i 'od rdul lhung tsam gyis// bdag yid padma tshim pa dang*// dngos grub sbrang rtsis byug par mdzod// ces dang ci shes pa'i tshig gis dngos grub gsol/

oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang*/ srin lag gis maṇḍal la reg pa dang bcas/ oṃ badzra muḥ maṇḍal gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdus nas/ maṇḍal gyi me tog dbus su spungs la phyis kyang 'di nyid la byi dor dang byug pa byas pa tsam gyis btub/ sa stegs byed nas lha las bslang ba sogs byas na legs te rdor sems mchod cho ga sogs su bshad pas so// bzhag go /de ltar 'bad pas tshogs myur du 'dzum pa dang*/ ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba tsam du ma zad/ gzhung las/ bsod nams las ni tshe 'phel zhing*// de 'phel 'chi ba slu ba yin// zhes dang*/ rang gi 'dod lha mchod sogs dang*// zhes sogs kyis tshogs bsags kyi cho ga thams cad 'chi slu'i mchog tu bzhed pa la bsams nas cung zad cig spros pa'o// tshul 'di ni lha gtso rkyang gi rigs gzhan la'ang 'gre shes par bya ste/ dper na gnyan sgrol ljang gu lta bu la/ dbus su sgrol ma bskyed pa'i dbu la don yod grub pa dang*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du mi bskyod pa 'god/ mi g.yo ba 'jam dbyangs phyag rdor rnam 'joms sogs la dbus su lha de dang de bkod pa'i dbu la mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'od dpag med nub tu 'god/ tsunda dang 'od zer can lta bu rigs bdag rnam snang can gyi tshe mi bskyod pa shar du 'byung ba sogs rgya cher shes par bya zhing*/ kun la'ang mchod 'bul gyi tshig rkang rjes ma/ bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// ces pa tsam dang sngags kyi go rim brje/ gtor ma rang rang gi gzhung bzhin nam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags gsham du gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā di swā hā zhes btags pas dbul/ khyad chos phra mo rnams ni smos ci dgos/ 'dod lha dmigs bsal med na dbus su mi bskyod pa bskyed cing bsang chu bsgrub pa'i sngon du bdag med pa'i don dran par byas nas gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod de 'jug

gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod pa'i tshul ni rang rang gi gzhung las rtogs par bya'o// zhar las 'ong ba tshe sogs spel ba'i 'khor lo bri sgrub rgyas pa gzhan dang gzhan du bzhugs pa'i par bkab lta bur mdzad pa'i srol yod pa ltar na rgya shog sogs gzhi gtsang mar/ thugs kar bsgom bya'i 'khor lo ji lta ba la/ gzhan la ster rgyu yin na/ ma ma zhes pa'i tshab tu dhā ra ka sya zhes gzhug bri tshar ba dang dri bzang gis byug bdag bskyed dang*/ 'khor lo la sbyang khrus sngon du 'gro bas rje btsun ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod bstod/ spyan dbye gsol gdab bcas byas nas/ rje btsun ma 'od du zhu ba las bris ba'i 'khor lo ji lta bar gyur par bsams la sngags rnams brgya rtsa brgyad tsam re bzla/ brtan bzhugs dang shis pa brjod/ bltab dang dkris sogs spyi ltar byas nas rang gzhan gyi lus la bcangs na rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang gis mtho ris kyi yon tan mtsho'i padma bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ro// smras pa/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub bo zhes// gsungs pa bcud len la sogs pas// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe grub na// 'bad pas mngon du byed la dgongs// 'tshe ba'i mthar thug gshin rje ste// de rgyu bdag tu kun rmongs pa// gnyen po'i mthar thug gang zag dang*// chos kyi de nyid yongs shes la// de yang dge rtsa rdzogs pa las// 'bad rtsol med par skye bas na// thabs mang spyod pa bde ba'i tshul// mkhas pa 'jug pa'i lam po che// de phyir lhag bsam ma smad las// zab don yi ger bsdebs pa'i tshe// 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'dzum bzhin du// shes pa'i me tog 'thor ram snyam// ngal ba las skyes bsod nams des// 'gro kun srid zhi'i phun tshogs kyis// brgyan pa'i rkang stegs mnan bzhin du// 'chi med rdo rje'i sar bgrod shog /thub pa'i chos tshul snang byed cing*// 'gro ba'i gdung sel dam pa'i zla// gang dag mchis kun srid mtha'i bar// gdul bya'i gtsug na brtan gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni rang nyid kyi 'dun pa brtas pa'i khar/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen drung ram pa tshul khrims rab rgyas kyis myur du dgos zhes bskul bas rkyen byas te/ bya bral ba 'khyams po ngag dbang legs grub kyis le lo'i bdud las byol te bri bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas shis pa'i me tog spyi bor bcings pas spro ba cher bskyed de grub par bgyis pa byā maṅga la bha wa tu/

slar yang mchan gyi sgo nas gsal bar byas shing*/ bcud len gyi sbyor tshad sogs rje thams cad mkhyen pa la bka' 'drir zhus te dag par bgyis pa'o // ༈ /rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa 'chi med grub pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ārya tā rā tsintā tsakrā ya/ 'dir rten gyi gang zag lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs shing*/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgom bzlas thun mong ma yin pa la brten nas tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub bsgrub par 'dod pas/ 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas legs par mnos te nyams len la 'jug par bya'o// de la'ang sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ snying rje chen po'i blo shugs drag tu bskyed bzhin pa'i ngang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos te/ thub dbang sgrol ma ngag gi dbang phyug dang*// rdo rje gdan pa ba ri gle nag pa// bshes gnyen sgre pa dwags po sgom tshul rje// shes rab byang chub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'dul 'dzin 'bri gung gling pa dam chos gling*// chos kyi tshul khrims lha lung thog gnas pa// chos dbang byang chub bzang po maṅga la// bsod nams lha dbang rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan rgyal mtshan rje btsun phrin las pa// tshar chen mkhyen brtse bslab gsum dbang rab zhabs// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang*// rin chen 'jam dpal rnams la= /blo gsal bstan 'dzin kun blo chos nyid mtshan// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen dang*// badzra ratna brgyud srol kun 'dus pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab dang tshogs gnyis mthus// 'phags ma'i gsang gsum gsal snang mthar phyin zhing*// 'od zer spro bsdus mchog thun phrin las dang*// 'chi med ye shes 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ces brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/

skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// sogs kyis skyabs sems bya/ rang nyid skad cig 'phags ma'i skur gsal ba'i// thugs ka'i zla steng tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas// bla ma snang mthas dbur brgyan rje btsun ma// 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na ma ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥs phyag bya/ oṃ gu ru ārya tā ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas chos thams cad 'od gsal stong nyid kyi dbyings su sbyangs te mnyam par bzhag pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa rnams bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po thun mong du lha sgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad dkar dang*// a las zla steng rang sems tām̐ dkar po// de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs gyur las// rang nyid sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo ni// ston zla'i mdangs can bcu drug lang tshos sgeg /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ye shes spyan bdun mdzes// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas utpal dkar// me tog 'bras bu gong bus dud pa bsnams// mthon mthing ltar gnag dbu skra'i zur phud ni// ltag par bcings pa'i lan bu ring du 'phyang*// dar dang rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol la brten nas// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung drang por bzhugs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis// ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis med thim// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs nas// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas// sku gang sgrib dag gyen tu 'khyil ba las// rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan gyur// oṃ ārya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod cing*/ lha'i nga rgyal dang rnam pa'i gsal snang la sems bzung*/ gnyis pa 'di'i khyad par gyi dmigs rim/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal gdab pa/1 rigs bdag 'pho ba/2 srung 'khor bsgom pa/3 tshe bcud bsdu ba/4 sngags bzla ba rnams rim par/5 thugs 1kar zla ba'i rang bzhin 'khor lo dkar// rtsibs brgyad mu khyud lnga ldan lte bar tām̐// mtha' skor spel tshig mdun rgyab oṃ dang hā// rtsibs brgyad tā re la sogs yig 'bru brgyad// mu khyud rnams la rim bzhin dbyangs g.yon/ gsal g.yas/ dang*// rten snying rdo sngon po/ ra 'od lnga'i phreng bas bskor// spyi bor 'od 2dpag med pa yongs gyur las// bla ma bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// dkar dmar mdangs can mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// rang gi phyi rol 3'khor lo dkar po'i gur// g.yas 'khor me 'bar gdon bgegs bar chad bsregs// thugs ka'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng bcas pa las// dkar ser dmar mthing ljang dang mchin kha'i 'od// rim par 'phros pas lus kyi nang kun gang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog gi phrin las rnams// rim dang gcig car 'grub cing brtan par byas// lhag ma ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pas// 'khor lo'i phyi nas 'od kyi gur khang drug /sgo nga'i rnam pa lta bur gcig gyur pa'i// bar mtshams utpal sngon po gsar pas gtams// rab 'byams las kyi dngos grub kun 'grub cing*// rigs bdag thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// rang gi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang*// srid zhi'i tshe bcud bsdus nas bum par thim// bdud rtsi'i rgyun lud tshangs pa'i sgo nas zhugs// lus kun khyab pas dus min 'chi ba sbyangs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/

rlung bum pa can ci rigs 'dzin pas brtan par bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i tām̐ yig sngags bcas las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang 'od zer dkar po ni// sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa dpag med 'phros// lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs// tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan spel// mthar ni ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kyang*// bdud rtsis zil pa phram mer gtams pa yis// 'chi med 'phags ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur// oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ ci nus dang*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇye dzñā na paṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla/ gsum pa rjes ni/ thun las ldang bar brtsams pa na mchod cing bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yis// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zhi ba dang*// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya rnams tshar gsum res sngags kyi byin rlabs brtan cing lhag chad kha bskang*/ snod bcud srung 'khor 'od zhu rang nyid dang*// rang yang rim gyis 'od gsal ngang du thim// slar yang yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur// dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan// phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing skyes nas// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug bsnyen pa byed na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra bcas thun bzhi'i rim pas rab dus bsnyen zla ba drug 'bring grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag brgyad cu/ tha ma'ang 'bum phrag bcu/ spel tshig dang bcas pa'ang de'i bcu cha tsam bzla/ phyi thun gyi mthar gtor ma 'bul/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas kha skong gi sbyin sreg 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa ltar bya zhing*/

gzhan yang dmigs rim gyi zhib gnad dang*/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum sogs rgyas par tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung bzhin 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ ngor e wam̐ pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig bde ldan mgon po'i zhal lung dang*/ nyer mkho'i yi ge/ kho bos byas pa'i sgrub mchod kyi yi ge sogs las rtogs par bya ba kho na'o// zhes pa'ang tshe mchog bsam gtan gling gi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po mtshungs med ye shes bzang pos brgyud 'debs sgrub thabs dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig bris shig ces bka' stsal rin po che'i phreng bas skul ba la brten nas/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin lha ldan dge 'phel thugs rje'i lha khang du mdor bsdus tshigs bcad kyi phreng bar bsdebs pa'i dge bas/ bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing*/ 'gro kun 'chi med ye shes kyi sku myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /'phags ma sgrol ma la rtsa sngags dang sbyar ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don kun grub pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ gyis thar dang 'dod rgu'i nor ster// dpal dang g.yang sogs skal ba bzang pos// srid zhir sman mdzad gsang ba gsum bdag /mchog sbyin 'phags ma yum la 'dud do// tā re thugs bskyed rin chen gru bos// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal mtsho las// mkha' mnyam yid can rtag tu sgrol ba'i// rje btsun sgrol ma yum la 'dud do// tuttā re zhes byin rlabs bdud rtsis// 'jigs bcas rgud pa'i tsha gdung bsal nas// phan bde'i padmo rgyas par mdzad pa'i// gdung ba skyob ma yum la 'dud do// tu re khyod zhabs dran pa'i mod nas// gang 'dul mtshan dang sku yi bkod pas// bdag lta'i phongs pa kun las srung ba'i/

thugs rje myur ma yum la 'dud do// swā hā phrin las rdzogs ldan sprin gyis// dge legs nor bu'i gru char 'bebs pas// khams gsum 'gro kun dbugs 'byin stsol ba'i// yid bzhin 'khor lo yum la 'dud do// mdor na sras bcas rgyal ba yongs kyi// ye shes gcig bsdus 'phags ma khyod la// snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs so// byang chub bar du rjes su zungs shig /dam chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rig dang brtse ba'i// mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs pas// don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa'ang lhag pa'i lha mo 'di nyid la gcig tu gus pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pa de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ /bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs dam gnad nas skul ba'i gsol 'debs 'chi med tshe dang ye shes grub pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsinta tsakrā ya/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur ma// dran pas tshe dang ye shes mchog stsol ma// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rje btsun ma// snying nas dran no thugs rje'i 'jug pas skyongs// bdag cag deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor mchog thob mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes// dad pas bsnyen las srid zhi'i legs tshogs kun// 'phel ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig rje btsun ma// mi rtag ngan song sdug bsngal la brten nas// rjes dran drug dang las 'bras blang dor dang*// bsam gtan gzugs med ting 'dzin them skas nas// mngon mtho'i grong du 'khrid cig rje btsun ma// khams gsum 'khor bar sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i gzhi// las nyon kun 'byung 'gegs pa'i bslab gsum lam// tshul bzhin bsten las thar pa'i khang bzang du// zhi bde'i dbugs 'byin stsol cig rje btsun ma// khyad par 'gro kun mar shes drin dran zhing*// drin bzo'i slad du byams dang snying rje dang*// bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub spyod mchog gis// kun mkhyen lam bzang ston cig rje btsun ma// de tshe rnam dag dbang dang rjes gnang gis// rgyud smin dam tshig sdom par ldan pa dang*// zab don bsgom pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel cig rje btsun ma// bla ma mchog gsum gtsug gi nor bur thob// smon dang 'jug pa'i byang sems snying la shar// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs pas// bdag rgyud dag par mdzod cig rje btsun ma// bsnyen grub yan lag bzhi yi rnal 'byor gyis// rang lus 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur// gsal ba rab kyi ting 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i// bsam gtan grub par mdzod cig rje btsun ma// zab mo'i bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i mthus// rigs bdag 'chi med mgon por yongs shar zhing*// zla shel mdog can 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis// mi mthun phyogs las srungs shig rje btsun ma// rab dkar bdud rtsi'i snang bas sa gsum gyi// rgud cig phongs pa'i mun pa kun zhi nas// gser zhun 'od kyi phreng bas srid dang zhi'i// phun tshogs rgyas par mdzod cig rje btsun ma// padma rā ga'i mchil pa rnon po yis// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun dbang du 'du ba dang*// dbang sngon 'od kyi zhags pas gdug pa can// mtha' dag 'ching bar mdzod cig rje btsun ma// mar gad zhun ma'i snang bas reg pa'i mod// mchog thun dngos grub cig car 'grub dang bcas// slar yang 'od zer mchin kha'i drwa ba yis// brtan cing nus ldan mdzod cig rje btsun ma// rigs kyi bdag po'i thugs rje'i zil dngar gyis// tshe bsod dpal 'byor lang tsho dar babs pas// thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i bdud rtsis gsos btab pas// 'chi med grub par mdzod cig rje btsun ma// mdor na snang grags rig gsum 'phags ma yi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang bar byin brlabs nas// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub kyis// don gnyis 'grub par mdzod cig rje btsun ma// gzhan yang snod bcud rgud pa kun zhi zhing*// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan bshad sgrub bstan pa dar// 'gro kun rdzogs ldan 'byor pas mngon mtho ba'i// bkra shis snang ba stsol cig rje btsun ma// zhes 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/

thun mong ma yin pa'i zab 'khrid kyi lam rim dang 'brel ba 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi gnam lo gsar du 'char ba'i dus kyi dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gsol ba btab pa'i yi ge pa ni/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dge bas 'gro kun 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston la yongs su spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
